From mindmap to blueprint.

One small language for every kind of figure — pretty by default, precise when it has to be.

lini.rs — the tour, the reference, the gallery, and the compiler in your browser

Thirty-odd lines of Lini — samples/hero.lini.

--- ## What it is A compiler: plain text in, clean themeable SVG out. You say where things go, and the parts you'd rather not do by hand — routing a wire through the gaps, measuring a dimension, picking a palette — are done for you. - **One grammar, every family.** Flowcharts, mindmaps, org charts, tables, ER schemas, sequences, charts, engineering drawings, floor plans, and circuit schematics are all layouts over the same nodes and links. Not ten tools with ten syntaxes — one language, so theming, baking, and diffing work identically in each. - **Themeable after export.** Every colour is a live CSS variable and a `light-dark()` pair, so one SVG follows the viewer's OS with no script and no re-render, and one line of host CSS recolours every diagram on a page. - **Fast and deterministic.** A typical figure compiles in about 2 ms, byte-identical every run, so SVGs diff cleanly in CI. - **No runtime.** A single native binary. No Node, no headless browser, nothing to stand up beside it. - **Agents can write it.** [`SKILL.md`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/SKILL.md) is the whole language as a working brief, and the property schema is generated from the compiler's own ledger. ## Gallery
Charts
 ER schemas
Sequence diagrams
 Icons & signs
Circuit schematics
 Engineering drawings
Floor plans
 Mindmaps & trees
More, with their source, at [lini.rs/gallery](https://lini.rs/gallery/). ## Colour

One file, both modes — samples/palette.lini.

Eleven named hues — `red rose orange amber lime green teal sky blue purple gray` — each in five **job-named** tiers: `wash` for backgrounds, `soft`, the bare name, `deep` for strokes, `ink` for text. The names hold across the flip — `--teal-ink` is the high-contrast tone in *both* modes, where a `light`/`dark` name would invert — which is what lets one export serve both. OKLCH underneath, so every ramp is perceptually even, and `gradient(--rose, --sky)` blends any two at a flattering angle. ## Install ```bash cargo install lini ``` ```bash lini diagram.lini -o diagram.svg # compile to SVG lini serve diagram.lini # live-reloading preview lini serve samples/ # browse and edit the bundled examples ``` Six lines — a type define, a container, and two links Lini routes for you: ``` { |svc::box| { fill: --teal-wash; stroke: --teal-ink } } |group| "Services" [ |svc#api| "API"; |svc#auth| "Auth" ] |svc#db| "Postgres" api -> db "read" auth -> db "write" ``` `{ }` is style, `[ ]` is children, and naming two nodes draws an orthogonal path between them, clear of everything in the way. The rest of the grammar is the [tour](https://lini.rs/docs/tour/language.html). ## Use it in your project - **[mdbook-lini](https://github.com/monfa-red/mdbook-lini)** — ` ```lini ` fences in an mdBook, compiled to inline SVG at build time. On [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/mdbook-lini). - **[rehype-lini](https://github.com/monfa-red/rehype-lini)** — the same fences anywhere [rehype](https://github.com/rehypejs/rehype) runs: Docusaurus, Next and MDX, or a bare `unified()` pipeline. A toggle reveals the source that drew each figure. On [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/rehype-lini): `npm install rehype-lini`. - **[astro-lini](https://github.com/monfa-red/astro-lini)** — the Astro integration: one line in `astro.config.mjs` and every fence in the site draws. On [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/astro-lini): `npm install astro-lini`. - **[remark-lini](https://github.com/monfa-red/remark-lini)** — the engine both of those run on, and the remark plugin for a pipeline that needs the figures drawn before a highlighter sees them. On [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/remark-lini-lang) as `remark-lini-lang`, since npm refuses the short name as one edit from `remark-lint`. - **[lini-wasm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/lini-wasm)** — the compiler itself, for JavaScript. One package, two builds, so it runs in Node, Bun, Deno, a bundler or a browser. This is what the integrations above ride on, and what to reach for to build one of your own. - **Editors** — search *Lini* in the extensions pane: a TextMate bundle on the [VS Code Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=monfa-red.lini) and a tree-sitter extension in [Zed's registry](https://zed.dev/extensions?query=lini). Source for both under [`editors/`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/tree/main/editors). Their word lists are generated from the compiler's own tables, so a new property highlights the day it lands. - **As a library** — `lini` is a crate as well as a binary: [docs.rs/lini](https://docs.rs/lini). ### From the community Built and maintained by their own authors, on their own release schedules. - **[obsidian-lini-view](https://github.com/FoxMaint/obsidian-lini-view)** — the Obsidian plugin: a ` ```lini ` fence draws in the note itself, live in the editor, on `lini-wasm`. ## For agents - **[`SKILL.md`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/SKILL.md)** — the language as a working brief: the write → compile → *look at the render* loop, every family, and the mistakes worth not making. Also served at [lini.rs/SKILL.md](https://lini.rs/SKILL.md). - **[`schema/lini.schema.json`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/schema/lini.schema.json)** — every primitive, template, role, and property with its owner, value shape, resolved default, inheritance channel, and a compiled example. Generated from the same ledger the compiler reads, and CI fails on drift. [`schema/reference.md`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/schema/reference.md) is the compact human mirror. - **`lini --json`** — diagnostics as JSON: stable codes, spans, and machine-applicable fixes. ## Go deeper - [The tour](https://lini.rs/docs/tour/language.html) — fourteen pages, start to finish. - [The reference](https://lini.rs/docs/reference/00-at-a-glance.html) — every property, split out of the spec. - [The gallery](https://lini.rs/gallery/) — finished figures, with the source that drew them. - [The playground](https://lini.rs/play/) — the compiler, compiled to wasm, in your browser. In this repo: [`SPEC.md`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/SPEC.md) is the language contract, frozen for 1.x — syntax, property names, defaults, diagnostic codes, and the theming surface stay compatible. [`ROUTING.md`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/ROUTING.md) is the routing contract. [`samples/`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/tree/main/samples) holds one file per feature area, and [`RELEASING.md`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/RELEASING.md) says how the pieces ship together. ## License MIT — see [LICENSE](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/LICENSE).

        v2=(v2+v3)&M64; v3=rotl(v3,16); v3^=v2
        v0=(v0+v3)&M64; v3=rotl(v3,21); v3^=v0
        v2=(v2+v1)&M64; v1=rotl(v1,17); v1^=v2; v2=rotl(v2,32)
    n=len(data); end=n-(n%8)

// Built-in type registry: every template lowers onto a primitive, with a
// chain of `.lini-*` classes whose defaults cascade base-first.

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Prim {
    Block,
    Oval,
    Hex,
    Slant,
    Cyl,
    Diamond,
    Poly,
    Path,
    Sketch,
    Line,
    Icon,
    Image,
    Text,
}

impl Prim {
    pub fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Prim::Block => "block",
            Prim::Oval => "oval",
            Prim::Hex => "hex",
            Prim::Slant => "slant",
            Prim::Cyl => "cyl",
            Prim::Diamond => "diamond",
            Prim::Poly => "poly",
            Prim::Path => "path",
            Prim::Sketch => "sketch",
            Prim::Line => "line",
            Prim::Icon => "icon",
            Prim::Image => "image",
            Prim::Text => "text",
        }
    }
}

pub struct TypeDef {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub prim: Prim,
    pub base: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defaults: &'static str,
}

macro_rules! t {
    ($n:expr, $p:ident, $b:expr, $d:expr) => {
        TypeDef { name: $n, prim: Prim::$p, base: $b, defaults: $d }
    };
}

// Registry order is the order type rules are emitted in the stylesheet.
pub static TYPES: &[TypeDef] = &[
    t!("block", Block, None, "fill: none; stroke: none; stroke-width: 2; padding: 0; gap: 36;"),

// Built-in type registry: every template lowers onto a primitive, with a
// chain of `.lini-*` classes whose defaults cascade base-first.

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Prim {
    Block,
    Oval,
    Hex,
    Slant,
    Cyl,
    Diamond,
    Poly,
    Path,
    Sketch,
    Line,
    Icon,
    Image,
    Text,
}

impl Prim {
    pub fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Prim::Block => "block",
            Prim::Oval => "oval",
            Prim::Hex => "hex",
            Prim::Slant => "slant",
            Prim::Cyl => "cyl",
            Prim::Diamond => "diamond",
            Prim::Poly => "poly",
            Prim::Path => "path",
            Prim::Sketch => "sketch",
            Prim::Line => "line",
            Prim::Icon => "icon",
            Prim::Image => "image",
            Prim::Text => "text",
        }
    }
}

pub struct TypeDef {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub prim: Prim,
    pub base: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defaults: &'static str,
}

macro_rules! t {
    ($n:expr, $p:ident, $b:expr, $d:expr) => {
        TypeDef { name: $n, prim: Prim::$p, base: $b, defaults: $d }
    };
}

153 /workspace/README.md
28:A compiler: plain text in, clean themeable SVG out. You say where things go, and the parts you'd rather not do by hand — routing a wire through the gaps, measuring a dimension, picking a palette — are done for you.
31:- **Themeable after export.** Every colour is a live CSS variable and a `light-dark()` pair, so one SVG follows the viewer's OS with no script and no re-render, and one line of host CSS recolours every diagram on a page.
92:Eleven named hues — `red rose orange amber lime green teal sky blue purple gray` — each in five **job-named** tiers: `wash` for backgrounds, `soft`, the bare name, `deep` for strokes, `ink` for text. The names hold across the flip — `--teal-ink` is the high-contrast tone in *both* modes, where a `light`/`dark` name would invert — which is what lets one export serve both. OKLCH underneath, so every ramp is perceptually even, and `gradient(--rose, --sky)` blends any two at a flattering angle.
103:lini serve samples/                # browse and edit the bundled examples
106:Six lines — a type define, a container, and two links Lini routes for you:
126:- **[lini-wasm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/lini-wasm)** — the compiler itself, for JavaScript. One package, two builds, so it runs in Node, Bun, Deno, a bundler or a browser. This is what the integrations above ride on, and what to reach for to build one of your own.
127:- **Editors** — search *Lini* in the extensions pane: a TextMate bundle on the [VS Code Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=monfa-red.lini) and a tree-sitter extension in [Zed's registry](https://zed.dev/extensions?query=lini). Source for both under [`editors/`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/tree/main/editors). Their word lists are generated from the compiler's own tables, so a new property highlights the day it lands.
139:- **[`schema/lini.schema.json`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/schema/lini.schema.json)** — every primitive, template, role, and property with its owner, value shape, resolved default, inheritance channel, and a compiled example. Generated from the same ledger the compiler reads, and CI fails on drift. [`schema/reference.md`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/schema/reference.md) is the compact human mirror.
149:In this repo: [`SPEC.md`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/SPEC.md) is the language contract, frozen for 1.x — syntax, property names, defaults, diagnostic codes, and the theming surface stay compatible. [`ROUTING.md`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/ROUTING.md) is the routing contract. [`samples/`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/tree/main/samples) holds one file per feature area, and [`RELEASING.md`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/RELEASING.md) says how the pieces ship together.

# usage: dwf.py [-n LINES] [-b BIN] file.lini ... : diff original vs ours for each file
import subprocess, sys, os, difflib
args = sys.argv[1:]
n = 40
mine = '/tmp/bin-link2/executable'
extra = []
files = []
i = 0
while i < len(args):
    a = args[i]
    if a == '-n':
        n = int(args[i + 1]); i += 2; continue
    if a == '-b':
        mine = args[i + 1]; i += 2; continue
    if a == '-a':
        extra = args[i + 1].split(); i += 2; continue
    files.append(a); i += 1
for f in files:
    d = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(f)); b = os.path.basename(f)
    r1 = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable'] + extra + [b], capture_output=True, cwd=d)
    r2 = subprocess.run([mine] + extra + [b], capture_output=True, cwd=d)
    print('=== %s  exit %d/%d' % (f, r1.returncode, r2.returncode))
    e1 = r1.stderr.decode(errors='replace').splitlines()
    e2 = r2.stderr.decode(errors='replace').splitlines()
    o1 = r1.stdout.decode(errors='replace').splitlines()
    o2 = r2.stdout.decode(errors='replace').splitlines()
    cnt = 0
    for l in difflib.unified_diff(e1, e2, 'orig-err', 'mine-err', lineterm='', n=0):
        print(l); cnt += 1
        if cnt > n: break
    cnt = 0
    for l in difflib.unified_diff(o1, o2, 'orig', 'mine', lineterm='', n=0):
        print(l); cnt += 1
        if cnt > n: break

from mh import *

sw = 2.0
m = sw / 2 + 1
mbx0 = x0p - m; mby0 = y - m; mbw = (x1p + m) - (x0p - m); mbh = (y + m) - (y - m)
print('ours', mask_id(mbx0, mby0, mbw, mbh, [cut_exact(-12.019500000000015, -63.0, [619.0], 1000.0, 11.0)]))
L = x1p - x0p
cands = {}
t = 0.35
cands['a'] = x0p + (x1p - x0p) * t
s = t * L
cands['b'] = x0p + (x1p - x0p) * (s / L)
cands['c'] = x0p * (1 - t) + x1p * t
cands['d'] = x0p + s
cands['e'] = x1p - (L - s)
cands['f'] = x1p + (x0p - x1p) * (1 - t)
cands['g'] = x0p + L * t
for k, v in cands.items():
    print(k, repr(v), mask_id(mbx0, mby0, mbw, mbh, [cut_exact(v, -63.0, [619.0], 1000.0, 11.0)]))
# brute force ulps around
import struct
def ulp_step(x, n):
    b = struct.unpack('<q', struct.pack('<d', x))[0]
    if x < 0:
        b -= n
    else:
        b += n
    return struct.unpack('<d', struct.pack('<q', b))[0]
for n in range(-40, 41):
    v = ulp_step(-12.019500000000015, n)
    h = mask_id(mbx0, mby0, mbw, mbh, [cut_exact(v, -63.0, [619.0], 1000.0, 11.0)])
    if h == 'a4492179':
        print('found ulp', n, repr(v))

arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# usage: p.py [-m] [-f filter] [-o] file-with-snippets
# Snippets separated by lines '----'. Runs the ORIGINAL (or ours with -m) on each.
# -a: all output; default: scene part only (filtered of centerlines)
# -d: diff original vs ours
import subprocess, sys, os, tempfile, re
ORIG = '/workspace/executable'
MINE = '/tmp/bin-annot/executable'
args = sys.argv[1:]
mode_all = '-a' in args
mine = '-m' in args
diff = '-d' in args
css = '-c' in args
extra = []
if '-x' in args:
    i = args.index('-x'); extra = args[i+1].split(); del args[i:i+2]
files = [a for a in args if not a.startswith('-')]
src = open(files[0]).read()
snips = [s.strip('\n') for s in re.split(r'^----.*$', src, flags=re.M)]
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='p_', dir='/tmp/annot')
def run(b, s):
    open(os.path.join(d, 'r_in.lini'), 'w').write(s)
    r = subprocess.run([b] + extra + ['r_in.lini'], capture_output=True, cwd=d, timeout=30)
    return r.stdout.decode(), r.stderr.decode(), r.returncode
def filt(o):
    if mode_all:
        return o
    lines = o.split('\n')
    out = []
    on = False
    for l in lines:
        if css and re.match(r'^    \.lini-scope-\w+ \.', l):
            out.append(re.sub(r'lini-scope-\w+ ', '', l))
        if 'lini-scene' in l:
            on = True
        if not on:
            continue
        if 'centerline' in l or re.match(r'^\s*</g>\s*$', l):
            continue
        if re.search(r'<line x1="-?\d+" y1="0" x2="\d+" y2="0"/>', l) or re.search(r'<line x1="0" y1="\d+" x2="0" y2="-\d+"/>', l):
            continue
        out.append(l)
    return '\n'.join(out)
for k, s in enumerate(snips):
    if not s.strip():
        continue
    print('=' * 20, k, s.split('\n')[-1][:80])
    if diff:
        o1, e1, c1 = run(ORIG, s)
        o2, e2, c2 = run(MINE, s)
        if (o1, e1, c1) == (o2, e2, c2):
            print('SAME')
        else:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# usage: p.py [-m] [-f filter] [-o] file-with-snippets
# Snippets separated by lines '----'. Runs the ORIGINAL (or ours with -m) on each.
# -a: all output; default: scene part only (filtered of centerlines)
# -d: diff original vs ours
import subprocess, sys, os, tempfile, re
ORIG = '/workspace/executable'
MINE = '/tmp/bin-annot/executable'
args = sys.argv[1:]
mode_all = '-a' in args
mine = '-m' in args
diff = '-d' in args
css = '-c' in args
extra = []
if '-x' in args:
    i = args.index('-x'); extra = args[i+1].split(); del args[i:i+2]
files = [a for a in args if not a.startswith('-')]
src = open(files[0]).read()
snips = [s.strip('\n') for s in re.split(r'^----.*$', src, flags=re.M)]
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='p_', dir='/tmp/annot')
def run(b, s):
    open(os.path.join(d, 'r_in.lini'), 'w').write(s)
    r = subprocess.run([b] + extra + ['r_in.lini'], capture_output=True, cwd=d, timeout=30)
    return r.stdout.decode(), r.stderr.decode(), r.returncode
def filt(o):
    if mode_all:
        return o
    lines = o.split('\n')
    out = []
    on = False
    for l in lines:
        if css and re.match(r'^    \.lini-scope-\w+ \.', l):
            out.append(re.sub(r'lini-scope-\w+ ', '', l))
        if 'lini-scene' in l:
            on = True
        if not on:
            continue
        if 'centerline' in l or re.match(r'^\s*</g>\s*$', l):
            continue
        if re.search(r'<line x1="-?\d+" y1="0" x2="\d+" y2="0"/>', l) or re.search(r'<line x1="0" y1="\d+" x2="0" y2="-\d+"/>', l):
            continue
        out.append(l)
    return '\n'.join(out)
for k, s in enumerate(snips):
    if not s.strip():
        continue
    print('=' * 20, k, s.split('\n')[-1][:80])
    if diff:
        o1, e1, c1 = run(ORIG, s)
        o2, e2, c2 = run(MINE, s)
        if (o1, e1, c1) == (o2, e2, c2):
            print('SAME')
        else:
            open(os.path.join(d, 'o1'), 'w').write(e1 + o1 + '[exit %d]\n' % c1)
            open(os.path.join(d, 'o2'), 'w').write(e2 + o2 + '[exit %d]\n' % c2)
            r = subprocess.run(['diff', os.path.join(d, 'o1'), os.path.join(d, 'o2')], capture_output=True)
            print('\n'.join(r.stdout.decode().split('\n')[:int(os.environ.get('DL', '40'))]))
        continue
    o, e, c = run(MINE if mine else ORIG, s)
    if e:
        print(e.rstrip())
    print(filt(o))
    if c:
        print('[exit %d]' % c)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# usage: cmp.py CASEFILE [-o] [-v] [-n N] [-a "args"]
# CASEFILE: snippets separated by lines '----'. Runs the original and ours on
# each; prints OK/FAIL and a short diff. -o: print the original's scene output
# instead. -v: full diff.
import subprocess, sys, os, tempfile, difflib

ORIG = '/workspace/executable'
MINE = '/tmp/bin-fp/executable'
args = sys.argv[1:]
show_orig = '-o' in args
verbose = '-v' in args
extra = []
nlines = 30
if '-a' in args:
    extra = args[args.index('-a') + 1].split()
if '-n' in args:
    nlines = int(args[args.index('-n') + 1])
path = args[0]
src = open(path).read()
cases = [c.strip('\n') for c in src.split('\n----\n')]
ok = 0
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir='/tmp/fp')
for k, c in enumerate(cases):
    if not c.strip():
        continue
    f = os.path.join(d, 'case.lini')
    open(f, 'w').write(c + '\n')
    r1 = subprocess.run([ORIG] + extra + ['case.lini'], capture_output=True, cwd=d)
    if show_orig:
        print('=== case %d: %s' % (k, c.split('\n')[0][:100]))
        out = r1.stdout.decode()
        if '<g class="lini-scene">' in out:
            out = out[:out.index('\n') + 1] + out[out.index('<g class="lini-scene">'):]
        sys.stdout.write(r1.stderr.decode())
        sys.stdout.write(out)
        if r1.returncode:
            print('[exit %d]' % r1.returncode)
        continue
    r2 = subprocess.run([MINE] + extra + ['case.lini'], capture_output=True, cwd=d, timeout=30)
    same = r1.stdout == r2.stdout and r1.stderr == r2.stderr and r1.returncode == r2.returncode
    if same:
        ok += 1
        print('OK   case %d: %s' % (k, c.split('\n')[0][:100]))
        continue
    print('FAIL case %d: %s' % (k, c.split('\n')[0][:100]))
    a = (r1.stderr.decode() + r1.stdout.decode() + '[exit %d]' % r1.returncode).split('\n')
    b = (r2.stderr.decode() + r2.stdout.decode() + '[exit %d]' % r2.returncode).split('\n')
    diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(a, b, 'orig', 'mine', n=0, lineterm=''))
    for l in diff[2:(None if verbose else nlines)]:
        print('   ' + l[:400])
if not show_orig:
    print('%d / %d OK' % (ok, len([c for c in cases if c.strip()])))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# helpers to run the original (and ours) on snippets
import subprocess, os, tempfile, re, sys

ORIG = '/workspace/executable'
MINE = '/tmp/bin-tree/executable'

def run(src, args=(), exe=ORIG):
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir='/tmp/tree/s')
    p = os.path.join(d, 'r_in.lini')
    with open(p, 'w') as f:
        f.write(src)
    r = subprocess.run([exe] + list(args) + ['r_in.lini'], capture_output=True, cwd=d)
    os.remove(p)
    os.rmdir(d)
    return r.stdout.decode(), r.stderr.decode(), r.returncode

def scene(out):
    i = out.find('<g class="lini-scene">')
    return out.split('\n')[0] + '\n' + out[i:]

def nodes(out):
    # list of (indent, classes, id, transform, rect)
    res = []
    lines = out.split('\n')
    for k, l in enumerate(lines):
        m = re.match(r'(\s*)<g class="lini-node ([^"]*)"(?: data-id="([^"]*)")?(?: style="[^"]*")? transform="translate\(([^,]*),([^)]*)\)', l)
        if m:
            rect = None
            if k + 1 < len(lines):
                mr = re.match(r'\s*<rect x="([^"]*)" y="([^"]*)" width="([^"]*)" height="([^"]*)"', lines[k + 1])
                if mr:
                    rect = tuple(float(x) for x in mr.groups())
            res.append((len(m.group(1)), m.group(2), m.group(3), float(m.group(4)), float(m.group(5)), rect))
    return res

def paths(out):
    return re.findall(r'<path d="([^"]*)"', out[out.find('<g class="lini-links">'):])

def cmp(src, args=()):
    a = run(src, args)
    b = run(src, args, MINE)
    return a == b, a, b

    src = sys.argv[1]
    o, e, c = run(src, sys.argv[2:])
    print(e, end='')
    print(scene(o) if o else '', end='')
    print('[exit %d]' % c)

import sys, struct, itertools
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/link2')
from mh import *
target = 'a4492179'
X0, X1, Y = -41.95500000000001, 43.57499999999999, -63.0
m = 2.0
mbx0 = X0 - m
mbw = (X1 + m) - (X0 - m)
def hid(xv):
    return mask_id(mbx0, Y - m, mbw, 4.0, [cut_exact(xv, Y, [619.0], 1000.0, 11.0)])
def walk(pts, s):
    acc = 0.0
    for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
        a, b = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
        l = abs(b - a)
        if acc + l >= s and l > 0:
            t = (s - acc) / l
            return [a + (b - a) * t, a + (s - acc) * (1 if b > a else -1), a + (b - a) * ((s - acc) / l)]
        acc += l
    return [pts[-1]]
for k in [12.0, 16.0, 6.0, 2.0, 3.5, 4.0, 8.0]:
    for pts in ([X0, X0 + k, X1 - k, X1], [X0, X0 + k, X1], [X0, X1 - k, X1]):
        L = sum(abs(pts[i + 1] - pts[i]) for i in range(len(pts) - 1))
        s = 0.35 * L
        for v in walk(pts, s):
            h = hid(v)
            print(k, len(pts), repr(v), h, '<==' if h == target else '')

import sys, struct
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/link2')
from mh import *
def ulp(x, n):
    if x == 0:
        return x
    b = struct.unpack('<q', struct.pack('<d', x))[0]
    b = b - n if x < 0 else b + n
    return struct.unpack('<d', struct.pack('<q', b))[0]
target = sys.argv[1]
Y = float(sys.argv[2])
X0 = float(sys.argv[3]); X1 = float(sys.argv[4])
LY = float(sys.argv[5])
R = int(sys.argv[6])
along = float(sys.argv[7]) if len(sys.argv) > 7 else 0.35
cnt = 0
for dx0 in range(-R, R + 1):
    for dx1 in range(-R, R + 1):
        x0 = ulp(X0, dx0); x1 = ulp(X1, dx1)
        L = x1 - x0
        lxs = set([x0 + (x1 - x0) * along, x0 + along * L, x0 * (1 - along) + x1 * along])
        for lx0 in lxs:
            for dl in range(-2, 3):
                lx = ulp(lx0, dl)
                for mbform in range(2):
                    if mbform == 0:
                        mx0, my0, mw, mh_ = x0 - 2, Y - 2, (x1 + 2) - (x0 - 2), (Y + 2) - (Y - 2)
                    else:
                        mx0, my0, mw, mh_ = x0 - 2, Y - 2, (x1 - x0) + 4, 4.0
                    h = mask_id(mx0, my0, mw, mh_, [cut_exact(lx, LY, [619.0], 1000.0, 11.0)])
                    cnt += 1
                    if h == target:
                        print('FOUND', dx0, dx1, dl, mbform, repr(x0), repr(x1), repr(lx))
print('done', cnt)

// Syntax tree for a Lini document.

use crate::diag::Span;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Doc {
    pub sheet: Option<Sheet>,
    pub stmts: Vec<Stmt>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Sheet {
    pub items: Vec<SheetItem>,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum SheetItem {
    Decl(Decl),
    Var(Decl),
    Binding(Binding),
    Rule(Rule),
    Define(Define),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Decl {
    pub name: String,
    pub name_span: Span,
    pub value: Value,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Binding {
    pub name: String,
    pub params: Option<Vec<String>>,
    pub expr: Term,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Rule {
    pub selector: Vec<Compound>,
    pub decls: Vec<Decl>,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Compound {
    pub bars: bool,
    pub type_name: Option<String>, // '-' for the link selector |-|
    pub id: Option<String>,
    pub classes: Vec<String>,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Define {
    pub name: String,
    pub base: String,
    pub decls: Vec<Decl>,
    pub body: Option<Vec<Stmt>>,
    pub span: Span,
    pub head_span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Value {
    // comma-separated groups, each a space-separated run of terms
    pub groups: Vec<Vec<Term>>,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Term {
    Num(f64, String, Span),
    Percent(f64, String, Span),
    Ident(String, Span),
    Str(String, Span),
    Hash(String, Span),
    Var(String, Span),
    Call(String, Vec<Expr>, Span),
    Group(Expr, Span),
    Tagged(Box<Term>, String, Span), // term ':' tag (draw segment names)
}

impl Term {
    pub fn span(&self) -> Span {
        match self {
            Term::Num(_, _, s)
            | Term::Percent(_, _, s)
            | Term::Ident(_, s)
            | Term::Str(_, s)
            | Term::Hash(_, s)
            | Term::Var(_, s)
            | Term::Call(_, _, s)
            | Term::Group(_, s)
            | Term::Tagged(_, _, s) => *s,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Expr {
    Num(f64, Span),
    Percent(f64, Span),
    Ident(String, Span),
    Str(String, Span),
    Var(String, Span),
    Hash(String, Span),
    Call(String, Vec<Expr>, Span),
    Unary(String, Box<Expr>, Span),
    Bin(String, Box<Expr>, Box<Expr>, Span),
    Ternary(Box<Expr>, Box<Expr>, Box<Expr>, Span),
    Tuple(Vec<Expr>, Span),
    Block(Vec<(String, Expr)>, Box<Expr>, Span), // (a = 1; b = 2; expr)
}

impl Expr {
    pub fn span(&self) -> Span {
        match self {
            Expr::Num(_, s)
            | Expr::Percent(_, s)
            | Expr::Ident(_, s)
            | Expr::Str(_, s)
            | Expr::Var(_, s)
            | Expr::Hash(_, s)
            | Expr::Call(_, _, s)
            | Expr::Unary(_, _, s)
            | Expr::Bin(_, _, _, s)
            | Expr::Ternary(_, _, _, s)
            | Expr::Tuple(_, s)
            | Expr::Block(_, _, s) => *s,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Stmt {
    Node(NodeStmt),
    Text(TextStmt),
    Link(LinkStmt),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct NodeStmt {
    pub type_name: Option<String>,
    pub id: Option<String>,
    pub label: Option<(String, Span)>,
    pub classes: Vec<String>,
    pub classes_span: Option<Span>,
    pub style: Option<Vec<Decl>>,
    pub style_span: Option<Span>,
    pub children: Option<Vec<Stmt>>,
    pub span: Span,
    pub head_span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct TextStmt {
    pub text: String,
    pub classes: Vec<String>,
    pub style: Option<Vec<Decl>>,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Endpoint {
    Path(PathRef),
    Node(Box<NodeStmt>),
    Text(String, Span),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct PathRef {
    pub parts: Vec<String>,
    pub index: Option<u32>,
    pub anchor: Option<String>,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct LinkStmt {
    // groups[i] are fanned endpoints; ops[i] joins groups[i] and groups[i+1]
    pub groups: Vec<Vec<Endpoint>>,
    pub ops: Vec<(String, Span)>,
    pub label: Option<(String, Span)>,
    pub classes: Vec<String>,
    pub style: Option<Vec<Decl>>,
    pub labels: Option<Vec<Stmt>>,
    pub span: Span,
}

import sys, struct, itertools, math
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/link2')
from mh import *
target = sys.argv[1]
Y = -63.0
X0 = 15.529999999999994
X1 = 101.05999999999997
along = 0.35
def walk_variants(xs, s):
    out = []
    acc = 0.0
    for i in range(len(xs) - 1):
        a, b = xs[i], xs[i + 1]
        l = abs(b - a)
        if acc + l >= s and l > 0:
            t = (s - acc) / l
            out.append(a + (b - a) * t)
            out.append(a + (s - acc))
            out.append(a * (1 - t) + b * t)
            break
        acc += l
    return out
mx0, my0, mw, mh_ = X0 - 2, Y - 2, (X1 + 2) - (X0 - 2), 4.0
mids = [27.53, 40.56, 80.56, 60.56, 52.56, 68.56, 89.06, 39.53, 77.06, 48.56, 72.56]
found = 0
for r in range(0, 4):
    for combo in itertools.combinations(mids, r):
        inner = sorted(combo)
        xs = [X0] + inner + [X1]
        # length as sum
        L = 0.0
        for i in range(len(xs) - 1):
            L += abs(xs[i + 1] - xs[i])
        s = along * L
        for lx in walk_variants(xs, s):
            h = mask_id(mx0, my0, mw, mh_, [cut_exact(lx, Y, [619.0], 1000.0, 11.0)])
            if h == target:
                print('FOUND', xs, repr(lx))
                found += 1
print('done', found)

import sys, struct
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/link2')
from mh import *
def ulp(x, n):
    if x == 0:
        return x
    b = struct.unpack('<q', struct.pack('<d', x))[0]
    b = b - n if x < 0 else b + n
    return struct.unpack('<d', struct.pack('<q', b))[0]
target = sys.argv[1]
Y = float(sys.argv[2])
X0 = float(sys.argv[3]); X1 = float(sys.argv[4])
R = int(sys.argv[5])
along = float(sys.argv[6])
LXs = [float(v) for v in sys.argv[7:]]
cnt = 0
for dya in range(-R, R + 1):
    ya = ulp(Y, dya)
    for dyb in range(-R, R + 1):
        yb = ulp(Y, dyb)
        y0, y1 = min(ya, yb), max(ya, yb)
        for dly in range(-R, R + 1):
            ly = ulp(Y, dly)
            for lx in LXs + [X0 + (X1 - X0) * along]:
                mx0, my0, mw, mh_ = X0 - 2, y0 - 2, (X1 + 2) - (X0 - 2), (y1 + 2) - (y0 - 2)
                h = mask_id(mx0, my0, mw, mh_, [cut_exact(lx, ly, [619.0], 1000.0, 11.0)])
                cnt += 1
                if h == target:
                    print('FOUND', dya, dyb, dly, repr(y0), repr(y1), repr(ly), repr(lx))
print('done', cnt)

import sys, struct
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/link2')
from mh import *
def ulp(x, n):
    if x == 0:
        return x
    b = struct.unpack('<q', struct.pack('<d', x))[0]
    b = b - n if x < 0 else b + n
    return struct.unpack('<d', struct.pack('<q', b))[0]
target = sys.argv[1]
Y = float(sys.argv[2])
X0 = float(sys.argv[3]); X1 = float(sys.argv[4])
LX = float(sys.argv[5]); R = int(sys.argv[6])
mx0, my0, mw, mh_ = X0 - 2, Y - 2, (X1 + 2) - (X0 - 2), 4.0
for d in range(-R, R + 1):
    lx = ulp(LX, d)
    for dly in range(-4, 5):
        ly = ulp(Y, dly)
        h = mask_id(mx0, my0, mw, mh_, [cut_exact(lx, ly, [619.0], 1000.0, 11.0)])
        if h == target:
            print('FOUND', d, dly, repr(lx), repr(ly))
print('done')

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/tree')
from lt import *

roots = ['R', 'Ri', 'RR', 'RRi', 'RRR', 'RRRi', 'RRRR']
for r in roots:
    for n in range(5, 13):
        b = 'B' * n
        src = '|column| { layout: tree; } [ |topic| "%s" [ |topic| "A" ; |topic| "%s" ] ]' % (r, b)
        o, e, c = run(src)
        ns = absnodes(o)
        ps = paths(o)
        root = [x for x in ns if x[0] == 1][0]
        bb = [x for x in ns if x[2] == 'lini-topic-2'][0]
        w = bb[5] + 2
        rw = root[5] + 2
        trunk = ps[1].split()[1]
        straight = 'A' not in ps[1]
        print(r, n, 'root half', rw / 2, 'shrunk', round(rw / 2 - 16, 4), 'B.x0+16', round(bb[3] - w / 2 + 16, 4), '| trunk', trunk, 'straight' if straight else 'Z')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# usage: gen_var.py base.lini 'line to append' ... -> prints original mask ids and ours for each variant
import subprocess, sys, os, re, tempfile
base = open(sys.argv[1]).read()
for extra in sys.argv[2:]:
    src = base + extra.replace('\\n', '\n') + '\n'
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='/tmp/link2/v.')
    open(d + '/r_in.lini', 'w').write(src)
    o = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'r_in.lini'], capture_output=True, cwd=d).stdout.decode()
    m = subprocess.run(['/tmp/bin-link2/executable', 'r_in.lini'], capture_output=True, cwd=d).stdout.decode()
    io = re.findall(r'lini-label-cut-([0-9a-f]{8})" ', o)
    im = re.findall(r'lini-label-cut-([0-9a-f]{8})" ', m)
    paths_o = re.findall(r'<path d="([^"]*)"', o)
    paths_m = re.findall(r'<path d="([^"]*)"', m)
    print('%-50s orig=%s mine=%s %s geo=%s' % (extra[:50], io, im, 'SAME' if io == im else 'DIFF', 'same' if paths_o == paths_m else 'diff'))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# show component box offsets for pin configurations
import sys, re
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/sch/scripts')
from summ import run

cfgs = sys.argv[1:]
for cfg in cfgs:
    # cfg like "L,L,R" sides
    pins = []
    for k, s in enumerate(cfg.split(',')):
        side = {'L': 'left', 'R': 'right', 'T': 'top', 'B': 'bottom', 'A': None, 'S': 'space'}[s]
        if side == 'space':
            pins.append('|space|')
        elif side:
            pins.append('|pin#p%d| { side: %s; }' % (k, side))
        else:
            pins.append('|pin#p%d|' % k)
    src = '|schematic| [ |component#d| "z" [ %s ] ]' % '; '.join(pins)
    o, e, c = run(src)
    m = re.search(r'data-id="d" transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)">\n\s*<rect x="([-\d.]+)" y="([-\d.]+)" width="([-\d.]+)" height="([-\d.]+)"', o)
    sm = re.search(r'lini-schematic lini-block" transform="[^"]+">\n\s*<rect x="([-\d.]+)" y="([-\d.]+)" width="([-\d.]+)" height="([-\d.]+)"', o)
    pinpos = re.findall(r'data-id="(p\d+)" transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)', o)
    print('%-12s comp@(%s,%s) rect y=%s h=%s  scope y=%s h=%s pins=%s %s' % (cfg, m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(4), m.group(6), sm.group(2), sm.group(4), [(p, y) for p, x, y in pinpos], e.strip()[:60]))

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/tree')
from lt import *

for w in [x / 2 for x in range(96, 120)]:
    for n in [12]:
        b = 'B' * n
        src = '|column| { layout: tree; } [ |topic| "R" { width: %s; } [ |topic| "A" ; |topic| "%s" ] ]' % (w, b)
        o, e, c = run(src)
        ns = absnodes(o)
        ps = paths(o)
        root = [x for x in ns if x[0] == 1][0]
        bb = [x for x in ns if x[2] == 'lini-topic-2'][0]
        bw = bb[5] + 2
        rw = root[5] + 2
        trunk = ps[1].split()[1]
        straight = 'A' not in ps[1]
        print(w, n, 'root half', rw / 2, 'B.x0+16', round(bb[3] - bw / 2 + 16, 4), '| trunk', trunk, 'straight' if straight else 'Z')

import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/scripts')
from tw import tw
def m3(ws,g=32):
    xs=[0.0]
    for i in range(1,len(ws)):
        xs.append(xs[-1]+ws[i-1]/2+g+ws[i]/2)
    off=(xs[0]-ws[0]/2 + xs[-1]+ws[-1]/2)/2
    return [x-off for x in xs]
def m1(ws,g=32):
    tot=sum(ws)+g*(len(ws)-1)
    c=-tot/2; xs=[]
    for w in ws:
        xs.append(c+w/2); c+=w+g
    return xs
def m2(ws,g=32):
    tot=0.0
    for w in ws: tot+=w
    tot+=g*(len(ws)-1)
    c=0.0; xs=[]
    for w in ws:
        xs.append(c+w/2); c+=w+g
    return [x-tot/2 for x in xs]
def m4(ws,g=32):
    # left edges accumulate, then centre by extents
    c=0.0; xs=[]
    for w in ws:
        xs.append(c+w/2); c+=w+g
    right=c-g
    off=right/2
    return [x-off for x in xs]
EOF

// Built-in type registry: every template lowers onto a primitive, with a
// chain of `.lini-*` classes whose defaults cascade base-first.

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Prim {
    Block,
    Oval,
    Hex,
    Slant,
    Cyl,
    Diamond,
    Poly,
    Path,
    Sketch,
    Line,
    Icon,
    Image,
    Text,
}

impl Prim {
    pub fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Prim::Block => "block",
            Prim::Oval => "oval",
            Prim::Hex => "hex",
            Prim::Slant => "slant",
            Prim::Cyl => "cyl",
            Prim::Diamond => "diamond",
            Prim::Poly => "poly",
            Prim::Path => "path",
            Prim::Sketch => "sketch",
            Prim::Line => "line",
            Prim::Icon => "icon",
            Prim::Image => "image",
            Prim::Text => "text",
        }
    }
}

pub struct TypeDef {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub prim: Prim,
    pub base: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defaults: &'static str,
}

macro_rules! t {
    ($n:expr, $p:ident, $b:expr, $d:expr) => {
        TypeDef { name: $n, prim: Prim::$p, base: $b, defaults: $d }
    };
}

import sys, re
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/sch/scripts')
from summ import run
cfg = sys.argv[1]
pins = []

    side = {'L': 'left', 'R': 'right', 'T': 'top', 'B': 'bottom'}[s]

src = '|schematic| [ |component#d| "z" [ %s ] ]' % '; '.join(pins)
o, e, c = run(src)
m = re.search(r'data-id="d" transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)">\n\s*<rect x="([-\d.]+)" y="([-\d.]+)" width="([-\d.]+)" height="([-\d.]+)"', o)

for l in o.split('\n'):
    if 'lini-row' in l or 'data-id="p' in l or 'part-value' in l or 'lini-ref' in l:
        print('   ', l.strip()[:120])
EOF
done

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/tree')
from lt import *

def info(w, kids, which):
    src = '|column| { layout: tree; } [ |topic| "R" { width: %s; } [ %s ] ]' % (w, ' ; '.join('|topic| "%s"' % k for k in kids))
    o, e, c = run(src)
    ps = paths(o)
    ns = absnodes(o)
    return 'A' not in ps[which], ps, ns

def thresh(kids, which, lo=20.0, hi=200.0):
    if not info(hi, kids, which)[0]:
        return None
    if info(lo, kids, which)[0]:
        return lo
    for _ in range(14):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        if info(mid, kids, which)[0]:
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid
    return round(hi, 3)

cases = [
    (['A', 'BBBBBBBBBBBB'], 1),
    (['BBBBBBBBBBBB', 'A'], 0),
    (['BBBBBBBBBBBB', 'AAAA'], 0),
    (['A', 'BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB', 'C'], 1),
    (['AAAA', 'BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB', 'C'], 1),
    (['A', 'BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB', 'CCCC'], 1),
    (['AAAAAA', 'BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB', 'CCCC'], 1),
    (['A', 'AAAA', 'BBBBBBBBBBBB'], 2),
]
for kids, which in cases:
    t = thresh(kids, which)
    ok, ps, ns = info(t if t else 150, kids, which)
    ws = [round(x[5] + 2, 4) for x in ns if x[0] == 2]
    xs = [x[3] for x in ns if x[0] == 2]
    print(kids, which, 'thr rect', t, 'outer', t and round(t + 2, 3), 'kid outer widths', ws, 'xs', xs)
    print('    ', ps)

import sys, struct
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/link2')
from mh import *
def ulp(x, n):
    if x == 0:
        return x
    b = struct.unpack('<q', struct.pack('<d', x))[0]
    b = b - n if x < 0 else b + n

// Syntax tree for a Lini document.

use crate::diag::Span;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Doc {
    pub sheet: Option<Sheet>,
    pub stmts: Vec<Stmt>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Sheet {
    pub items: Vec<SheetItem>,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum SheetItem {
    Decl(Decl),
    Var(Decl),
    Binding(Binding),
    Rule(Rule),
    Define(Define),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Decl {
    pub name: String,
    pub name_span: Span,
    pub value: Value,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Binding {
    pub name: String,
    pub params: Option<Vec<String>>,
    pub expr: Term,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Rule {
    pub selector: Vec<Compound>,
    pub decls: Vec<Decl>,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Compound {
    pub bars: bool,
    pub type_name: Option<String>, // '-' for the link selector |-|
    pub id: Option<String>,
    pub classes: Vec<String>,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Define {
    pub name: String,
    pub base: String,
    pub decls: Vec<Decl>,
    pub body: Option<Vec<Stmt>>,
    pub span: Span,
    pub head_span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Value {
    // comma-separated groups, each a space-separated run of terms
    pub groups: Vec<Vec<Term>>,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Term {
    Num(f64, String, Span),
    Percent(f64, String, Span),
    Ident(String, Span),
    Str(String, Span),
    Hash(String, Span),
    Var(String, Span),
    Call(String, Vec<Expr>, Span),
    Group(Expr, Span),
    Tagged(Box<Term>, String, Span), // term ':' tag (draw segment names)
}

impl Term {
    pub fn span(&self) -> Span {
        match self {
            Term::Num(_, _, s)
            | Term::Percent(_, _, s)
            | Term::Ident(_, s)
            | Term::Str(_, s)
            | Term::Hash(_, s)
            | Term::Var(_, s)
            | Term::Call(_, _, s)
            | Term::Group(_, s)
            | Term::Tagged(_, _, s) => *s,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Expr {
    Num(f64, Span),
    Percent(f64, Span),
    Ident(String, Span),
    Str(String, Span),
    Var(String, Span),
    Hash(String, Span),
    Call(String, Vec<Expr>, Span),
    Unary(String, Box<Expr>, Span),
    Bin(String, Box<Expr>, Box<Expr>, Span),
    Ternary(Box<Expr>, Box<Expr>, Box<Expr>, Span),
    Tuple(Vec<Expr>, Span),
    Block(Vec<(String, Expr)>, Box<Expr>, Span), // (a = 1; b = 2; expr)
}

impl Expr {
    pub fn span(&self) -> Span {
        match self {
            Expr::Num(_, s)
            | Expr::Percent(_, s)
            | Expr::Ident(_, s)
            | Expr::Str(_, s)
            | Expr::Var(_, s)
            | Expr::Hash(_, s)
            | Expr::Call(_, _, s)
            | Expr::Unary(_, _, s)
            | Expr::Bin(_, _, _, s)
            | Expr::Ternary(_, _, _, s)
            | Expr::Tuple(_, s)
            | Expr::Block(_, _, s) => *s,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Stmt {
    Node(NodeStmt),
    Text(TextStmt),
    Link(LinkStmt),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct NodeStmt {
    pub type_name: Option<String>,
    pub id: Option<String>,
    pub label: Option<(String, Span)>,
    pub classes: Vec<String>,
    pub classes_span: Option<Span>,
    pub style: Option<Vec<Decl>>,
    pub style_span: Option<Span>,
    pub children: Option<Vec<Stmt>>,
    pub span: Span,
    pub head_span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct TextStmt {
    pub text: String,
    pub classes: Vec<String>,
    pub style: Option<Vec<Decl>>,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Endpoint {
    Path(PathRef),
    Node(Box<NodeStmt>),
    Text(String, Span),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct PathRef {
    pub parts: Vec<String>,
    pub index: Option<u32>,
    pub anchor: Option<String>,
    pub span: Span,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct LinkStmt {
    // groups[i] are fanned endpoints; ops[i] joins groups[i] and groups[i+1]
    pub groups: Vec<Vec<Endpoint>>,
    pub ops: Vec<(String, Span)>,
    pub label: Option<(String, Span)>,
    pub classes: Vec<String>,
    pub style: Option<Vec<Decl>>,
    pub labels: Option<Vec<Stmt>>,
    pub span: Span,
}

  I found the key. The gradient id uses the same `hash8` (FNV-1a 64, folded) as the other ids, over a string built from the Rust `{:?}` formatting of the evaluated stop values:
  
  ```
  linear:  format!("linear {} {:?}", f4(angle), stops)   // gradient(...) uses angle 135
  radial:  format!("radial {:?}", stops)
  ```
  
  `f4` is the program's normal number formatter (`{:.4}`, trailing zeros trimmed, `-0` becomes `0`). `stops` is a `Vec<Value>` of the evaluated arguments, printed with derived Debug. These are the exact variant names (every one confirmed against real ids):
  
  | Source stop | Debug text in the key |
  |---|---|
  | `red`, `RED`, `px` (any bare word, case kept) | `Ident("red")` |
  | `1`, `round(19.6)`, `1+1` | `Number(1.0)`, `Number(-0.0)`, `Number(1e16)`, `Number(1e-5)`, `Number(NaN)`, `Number(inf)` |
  | `20%` | `Percent(20.0)` |
  | `#F00` (as written, no `#`); `oklch(...)` becomes lowercase hex | `Hex("F00")`, `Hex("f97770")` |
  | `"a\"b"` | `String("a\"b")` (Rust string escaping, e.g. `\u{301}`) |
  | `--blue`, `--x` (name only; the variable's value doesn't matter) | `LiveVar { name: "blue", raw: false }` |
  | `red 20%`, `20px` (space-separated) | `Tuple([Ident("red"), Percent(20.0)])` |
  | `rgb(1, 2, 3)`, `hsl`, `rgba`, `hsla`, nested calls (args evaluated) | `Call(ResolvedCall { name: "rgb", args: [Number(1.0), Number(2.0), Number(3.0)] })` |
  
  Examples: `gradient(red, blue)` hashes `linear 135 [Ident("red"), Ident("blue")]` to `a94e6447`, and `radial-gradient(1, 2)` hashes `radial [Number(1.0), Number(2.0)]` to `0975b715`.
  
  **Python reproduction:**
  ```python
  def hash8(s):
      h=0xcbf29ce484222325
      for b in s.encode(): h=((h^b)*0x100000001b3)&(2**64-1)
      return '%08x'%(((h>>32)^h)&0xffffffff)
  def f4(v):
      if v!=v or v in (float('inf'),float('-inf')): return {True:'NaN'}.get(v!=v, 'inf' if v>0 else '-inf')
      s='%.4f'%v; s=s.rstrip('0').rstrip('.') if '.' in s else s
      return '0' if s=='-0' else s
  def fdbg(v):   # Rust {:?} for f64
      if v!=v: return 'NaN'
      if v in (float('inf'),float('-inf')): return 'inf' if v>0 else '-inf'
      r=repr(v)
      if 'e' in r: m,e=r.split('e'); return '%se%d'%(m[:-2] if m.endswith('.0') else m,int(e))
      return r
  q=lambda s:'"'+s.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('"','\\"').replace('\n','\\n').replace('\t','\\t')+'"'
  def dbg(v):
      k=v[0]
      if k in('Ident','Hex','String'): return '%s(%s)'%(k,q(v[1]))
      if k in('Number','Percent'): return '%s(%s)'%(k,fdbg(float(v[1])))
      if k=='LiveVar': return 'LiveVar { name: %s, raw: false }'%q(v[1])
      if k=='Tuple': return 'Tuple([%s])'%', '.join(map(dbg,v[1]))
      if k=='Call': return 'Call(ResolvedCall { name: %s, args: [%s] })'%(q(v[1]),', '.join(map(dbg,v[2])))
  linear_id=lambda a,st: hash8('linear %s [%s]'%(f4(a),', '.join(map(dbg,st))))
  radial_id=lambda st: hash8('radial [%s]'%', '.join(map(dbg,st)))
  ```
  This simplified string escaping only covers quote, backslash, newline and tab. The full version is in `/tmp/core-hash/gradient_key.py` and also handles control and combining characters the way Rust does.

  - All 30 of your data points match, plus 13 more I probed (calls, strings, Unicode, NaN/inf angles, very large and very small numbers, oklch).
  - All 9 distinct gradients in the sample files under `assets/` match.
  - Two random fuzz runs compiled 300 gradients with the binary: 242 matched and none mismatched. The other 58 were rejected by the compiler because I generated out-of-range `rgb`/`hsl` values.
  - A Rust version using `#[derive(Debug)]` on an enum with exactly these names, compiled with the local toolchain, also reproduces the ids. So the Rust port can derive `Debug` on a matching enum and call `format!` directly, as long as variant and field names match exactly. That's `/tmp/core-hash/keycheck.rs`.
  
  **Things to know:**
  - The angle in the key is `f4(angle)`, not the rendered `rotate(angle-90)`. Stop numbers keep full precision, so `red 20.00001%` and `red 20%` get different ids even though both render as "red 20%".
  - I never saw `raw: true` in `LiveVar`. Palette, theme, custom, undefined, `--lini-…` and uppercase names all give `raw: false`. I don't know what triggers `true`.
  - Side observation on `lini-hatch-` ids, which I did not crack: the key uses the angle at full precision, the spacing rounded with `f4`, and the colour at full precision. It is not a simple join of those values.
  
  **How I got there:** a C brute-forcer over candidate key templates first cracked the radial form `radial [Ident("red"), Ident("blue")]`. The other variants came from smaller targeted searches. For `Call(ResolvedCall …)` I worked out its exact length and the hash state around it (length 44 for `rgb()`, the bytes after the args `" })"`, then `", args: ["`), then a meet-in-the-middle search found the remaining name.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# usage: rep.py file spec.txt
# spec.txt: blocks of "<<<<\nold\n====\nnew\n>>>>" ; each old must occur (all occurrences replaced unless prefixed '!1')
import sys, re
path, spec = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
s = open(path).read()
blocks = open(spec).read().split('<<<<\n')[1:]
for b in blocks:
    old, rest = b.split('\n====\n', 1)
    new = rest.rsplit('\n>>>>', 1)[0]
    once = False
    if old.startswith('!1'):
        once = True
        old = old[2:]
    n = s.count(old)
    if n == 0:
        print('NOT FOUND:', old[:80]); sys.exit(1)
    s = s.replace(old, new, 1 if once else -1)
    print('replaced %d: %s' % (1 if once else n, old.split(chr(10))[0][:70]))
open(path, 'w').write(s)

GOAL: find the exact string (key) that is hashed to produce gradient ids `lini-gradient-XXXXXXXX`, so we can reproduce them byte-exactly.

Known hash function used elsewhere in this program (verified): hash8(s) = format!("{:08x}", (h>>32) ^ (h & 0xffffffff)) where h = FNV-1a 64-bit over the UTF-8 bytes of s (offset basis 0xcbf29ce484222325, prime 0x100000001b3). Verified keys for other ids: the stylesheet scope `lini-scope-` = hash8(stylesheet text); shadow filter `lini-shadow-` = hash8(format!("{},{},{},{}", dx, dy, blur, flood_color)) e.g. hash8("2,3,3,rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)") = "803f42a2"; link label masks `lini-label-cut-` = hash8(format!("{:?} {:?} {:?} {:?} {:?}", x0, y0, w, h, cuts_vec)) (Rust Debug formatting of f64s and a Vec of tuples). The gradient id most likely uses the same hash8 but possibly over a different key, or it may use a different hash — determine which.

How gradients render (snippet `|box| { fill: gradient(red, blue) }` compiled with `cd /tmp/core-hash && /workspace/executable file.lini`):
  <linearGradient id="lini-gradient-a94e6447" gradientTransform="rotate(45 0.5 0.5)"><stop offset="0%" style="stop-color: red"/><stop offset="100%" style="stop-color: blue"/></linearGradient>
and the node gets style="fill: url(#lini-gradient-a94e6447)". Forms: `gradient(c1, c2, ...)` = linear with auto CSS angle 135 (rotate = angle-90 = 45); `linear-gradient(ANGLE, c1, c2, ...)` (rotate(ANGLE-90), not normalised: 370 -> rotate(280), 10.5 -> rotate(-79.5)); `radial-gradient(c1, c2, ...)` -> <radialGradient id=...> with no gradientTransform. Stop colour text is the CSS text of each argument (named colours pass through as written, e.g. RED stays RED; `--blue` becomes var(--lini-blue); numbers pass through e.g. `gradient(1, 2)`; `gradient(red 20%, blue)` has stop text "red 20%"; oklch(...) args are converted to hex).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# usage: findy.py file.lini [R] : for each masked straight horizontal wire whose label sits on it,
# brute-force the wire's exact y (ULP offsets) so that the mask id matches the original.
import sys, subprocess, re, os, struct
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/link2')
from mh import *
f = sys.argv[1]
R = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 5000
d = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(f)); b = os.path.basename(f)
o = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', b], capture_output=True, cwd=d).stdout.decode()
env = dict(os.environ); env['LINI_DBG_MASK'] = '1'
r = subprocess.run(['/tmp/bin-link2/executable', b], capture_output=True, cwd=d, env=env)
ids_o = re.findall(r'<mask id="lini-label-cut-([0-9a-f]{8})"', o)
dbg = [l for l in r.stderr.decode().splitlines() if l.startswith('MASK')]
def ulp(x, n):
    if x == 0:
        return x
    bb = struct.unpack('<q', struct.pack('<d', x))[0]
    bb = bb - n if x < 0 else bb + n
    return struct.unpack('<d', struct.pack('<q', bb))[0]
for idx, (line, target) in enumerate(zip(dbg, ids_o)):
    parts = line.split('|')
    x0, y0, x1, y1, sw, wavy = parts[0].split()[1:7]
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = float(x0), float(y0), float(x1), float(y1)
    labs = []
    for p in parts[1:]:
        t = p.split()
        lx, ly, tw, fs, upem = map(float, t[:5])
        units = [float(v) for v in re.findall(r'[-0-9.e]+', ' '.join(t[5:]))]
        labs.append((lx, ly, units, upem, fs))
    m = float(sw) / 2 + 1
    if y0 != y1:
        print(idx, 'not horizontal', line)
        continue
    found = None
    for dlt in range(0, R + 1):
        for sgn in ([1, -1] if dlt else [1]):
            y = ulp(y0, dlt * sgn)
            cuts = []
            for (lx, ly, units, upem, fs) in labs:
                lyy = y if ly == y0 else ly
                cuts.append(cut_exact(lx, lyy, units, upem, fs))
            h = mask_id(x0 - m, y - m, (x1 + m) - (x0 - m), (y + m) - (y - m), cuts)
            if h == target:
                found = (dlt * sgn, y)
                break
        if found:
            break
    print(idx, target, 'y=%r' % y0, '->', found)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# write variant files for the port solver study and run findy on each
import subprocess, os, sys
os.makedirs('/tmp/link2/sv', exist_ok=True)
tmpl = '''{ layout: grid; columns: repeat(2); clearance: %(k)s }
|box#a| "A"%(ah)s
|box#b| "B"%(bh)s
|box#c| "C"
|box#d| "D"
a -> b%(l0)s
a -> b%(l1)s
%(extra)s
'''
cases = []
for k in [8, 10, 12, 16, 20]:
    for which in [0, 1]:
        cases.append(dict(k=k, ah='', bh='', l0=' "X"' if which == 0 else '', l1=' "X"' if which == 1 else '', extra='c -> b:left', name='k%d_w%d' % (k, which)))
for which in [0, 1]:
    cases.append(dict(k=12, ah='', bh=' { height: 100 }', l0=' "X"' if which == 0 else '', l1=' "X"' if which == 1 else '', extra='c -> b:left', name='bh100_w%d' % which))
    cases.append(dict(k=12, ah='', bh='', l0=' "X"' if which == 0 else '', l1=' "X"' if which == 1 else '', extra='c -> b:left\nc -> b:left', name='two_w%d' % which))
for c in cases:
    p = '/tmp/link2/sv/%s.lini' % c['name']
    open(p, 'w').write(tmpl % c)
    r = subprocess.run(['python3', '/tmp/link2/findy.py', p, sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '3000'], capture_output=True)
    print(c['name'], r.stdout.decode().strip())

    if not defs:
        print(a, 'ERR', err.strip()[:200]); continue
    d = defs[0]
    m = re.search(r'rotate\(([^ ]*) ', d[3])
    rot = m.group(1) if m else d[3]

# variants for port solver study: (name, body links)
import subprocess, os, sys
os.makedirs('/tmp/link2/sv2', exist_ok=True)
head = '''{ layout: grid; columns: repeat(2); clearance: 12 }
|box#a| "A"
|box#b| "B"
|box#c| "C"
|box#d| "D"
'''
cases = {
    'one_plus1': 'a -> b "X"\nc -> b:left',

    'aside_w0': 'a -> b "X"\na -> b\na:right -> d',
    'aside_w1': 'a -> b\na -> b "X"\na:right -> d',
    'three_plus1_w0': 'a -> b "X"\na -> b\na -> b\nc -> b:left',
    'three_plus1_w1': 'a -> b\na -> b "X"\na -> b\nc -> b:left',
    'three_plus1_w2': 'a -> b\na -> b\na -> b "X"\nc -> b:left',
}
for name, body in cases.items():
    p = '/tmp/link2/sv2/%s.lini' % name

    print(name, r.stdout.decode().strip().replace('\n', ' || '))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# usage: dws.py [-n LINES] [-a "args"] files...  -> diff original vs /tmp/bin-seq/executable for each file
import subprocess, sys, os, difflib
args = sys.argv[1:]
n = 40
extra = []
mine = '/tmp/bin-seq/executable'
while args and args[0].startswith('-'):
    if args[0] == '-n': n = int(args[1]); args = args[2:]
    elif args[0] == '-a': extra = args[1].split(); args = args[2:]
    elif args[0] == '-b': mine = args[1]; args = args[2:]
    else: break
for f in args:
    d = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(f)); b = os.path.basename(f)
    r1 = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable'] + extra + [b], capture_output=True, cwd=d, text=True)
    r2 = subprocess.run([mine] + extra + [b], capture_output=True, cwd=d, text=True)
    same = r1.stdout == r2.stdout and r1.stderr == r2.stderr and r1.returncode == r2.returncode
    print('=====', f, 'OK' if same else 'DIFF', 'exit %d/%d' % (r1.returncode, r2.returncode))
    if same: continue
    if r1.stderr != r2.stderr:
        print('--- stderr orig:', r1.stderr.strip()[:500])
        print('--- stderr mine:', r2.stderr.strip()[:500])
    lines = list(difflib.unified_diff(r1.stdout.splitlines(), r2.stdout.splitlines(), 'orig', 'mine', n=0, lineterm=''))
    for l in lines[:n]: print(l)
    if len(lines) > n: print('... (%d more)' % (len(lines) - n))

Thirty-odd lines of Lini — samples/hero.lini.

--- ## What it is A compiler: plain text in, clean themeable SVG out. You say where things go, and the parts you'd rather not do by hand — routing a wire through the gaps, measuring a dimension, picking a palette — are done for you. - **One grammar, every family.** Flowcharts, mindmaps, org charts, tables, ER schemas, sequences, charts, engineering drawings, floor plans, and circuit schematics are all layouts over the same nodes and links. Not ten tools with ten syntaxes — one language, so theming, baking, and diffing work identically in each. - **Themeable after export.** Every colour is a live CSS variable and a `light-dark()` pair, so one SVG follows the viewer's OS with no script and no re-render, and one line of host CSS recolours every diagram on a page. - **Fast and deterministic.** A typical figure compiles in about 2 ms, byte-identical every run, so SVGs diff cleanly in CI. - **No runtime.** A single native binary. No Node, no headless browser, nothing to stand up beside it. - **Agents can write it.** [`SKILL.md`](https://github.com/monfa-red/lini/blob/main/SKILL.md) is the whole language as a working brief, and the property schema is generated from the compiler's own ledger. ## Gallery

import sys, re
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/sch/scripts')
from summ import run

HEAD = '''{ layout: schematic; gap: %s; |vcc::label| { symbol: power } [ "5V" ] }
|component#u1| "U" [ |pin#a| {side: left}; |pin#b| {side: left}; |pin#c| {side: right} ]
'''
def pos(svg, id_):
    m = re.search(r'data-id="%s" transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)' % id_, svg)
    return (float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2))) if m else None

def paths(svg):
    return re.findall(r'<path d="(M[^"]*)"/>\n    </g>', svg)

bodies = sys.argv[2:]
gaps = sys.argv[1].split(',')
for body in bodies:
    print('###', body)
    for g in gaps:
        src = HEAD % g + body.replace('\\n', '\n')
        o, e, c = run(src)
        u = pos(o, 'u1')
        ids = re.findall(r'data-id="([^"]+)" transform', o)
        tops = [i for i in ids if i not in ('a', 'b', 'c', 'u1', 'p1', 'p2', 'w', 'k')]
        rel = []
        for i in tops:
            p = pos(o, i)
            rel.append('%s(%g,%g)' % (i, p[0] - u[0], p[1] - u[1]))
        ls = re.findall(r'<g class="lini-link"[^>]*>\n\s*<path d="([^"]*)"', o)
        print('  gap %4s: %s | %s %s' % (g, ' '.join(rel), ' || '.join(ls), e.strip()[:80]))

ws=[111.81,115.035,91.39500000000001]
g=32.0
def check(xs,name):
    a=repr(xs[1]-23.5); b=repr((xs[2]-xs[1]+24)/2); c='%.4f'%((xs[0]+xs[1])/2)
    ok = a=='-13.29249999999999' and b=='79.60749999999999' and c=='-62.5037'
    print(('OK ' if ok else '   ')+name, [repr(x) for x in xs], a, b, c)
n=len(ws)
# m3 centre distances then shift by extents midpoint
d=[ws[k]/2+g+ws[k+1]/2 for k in range(n-1)]
xs=[0.0]
for k in range(n-1): xs.append(xs[-1]+d[k])
off=(xs[0]-ws[0]/2+xs[-1]+ws[-1]/2)/2
check([x-off for x in xs],'m3')
# m3b distances as (w_k + w_{k+1})/2 + g
d=[(ws[k]+ws[k+1])/2+g for k in range(n-1)]
xs=[0.0]
for k in range(n-1): xs.append(xs[-1]+d[k])
off=(xs[0]-ws[0]/2+xs[-1]+ws[-1]/2)/2
check([x-off for x in xs],'m3b')
# m3c: total width then start
d=[ws[k]/2+g+ws[k+1]/2 for k in range(n-1)]
tot=ws[0]/2+sum(d)+ws[-1]/2
x0=-tot/2+ws[0]/2
xs=[x0]
for k in range(n-1): xs.append(xs[-1]+d[k])
check(xs,'m3c')
# m1: cursor from -tot/2 (edges)
tot=sum(ws)+g*(n-1)
c=-tot/2; xs=[]
for w in ws:
    xs.append(c+w/2); c+=w+g
check(xs,'m1')
# m1b: tot computed by accumulation
tot=0.0
for k,w in enumerate(ws):
    tot+=w
    if k: tot+=g
c=-tot/2; xs=[]
for w in ws:
    xs.append(c+w/2); c+=w+g
check(xs,'m1b')
# m5: left edge 0, centre then subtract tot/2
c=0.0; xs=[]
for w in ws:
    xs.append(c+w/2); c+=w+g
tot=c-g
check([x-tot/2 for x in xs],'m5')
# m6: lefts then mid of extents
c=0.0; xs=[]
for w in ws:
    xs.append(c+w/2); c+=w+g
off=(xs[0]-ws[0]/2 + xs[-1]+ws[-1]/2)/2
check([x-off for x in xs],'m6')
# m7: lo/hi extents symmetric
d=[ws[k]/2+g+ws[k+1]/2 for k in range(n-1)]
xs=[0.0]
for k in range(n-1): xs.append(xs[-1]+d[k])
lo=xs[0]-ws[0]/2; hi=xs[-1]+ws[-1]/2
check([x-(lo+hi)/2 for x in xs],'m7')
check([x-lo-(hi-lo)/2 for x in xs],'m7b')
check([x+(-(hi-lo)/2-lo) for x in xs],'m7c')
# m8: start at x0 = w0/2
xs=[ws[0]/2]
for k in range(n-1): xs.append(xs[-1]+d[k])
tot=xs[-1]+ws[-1]/2
check([x-tot/2 for x in xs],'m8')
EOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# usage: dws.py [-n LINES] name...  -> diff original vs ours for named test files
# names: prop_x (test_doc_examples), s:drawing_x (test_samples), b:spec_042 (blocks), or a path
import subprocess, sys, os
args = sys.argv[1:]
n = 30
if args and args[0] == '-n':
    n = int(args[1]); args = args[2:]
def path(nm):
    if os.path.exists(nm): return nm
    if nm.startswith('s:'): return '/workspace/assets/test_samples/%s.lini' % nm[2:]
    if nm.startswith('b:'): return '/workspace/assets/test_doc_examples/blocks/%s.lini' % nm[2:]
    return '/workspace/assets/test_doc_examples/%s.lini' % nm
for nm in args:
    f = path(nm)
    d = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(f)); b = os.path.basename(f)
    r1 = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', b], capture_output=True, cwd=d)
    r2 = subprocess.run(['/tmp/bin-annot/executable', b], capture_output=True, cwd=d)
    o1 = r1.stderr.decode() + r1.stdout.decode() + '[exit %d]\n' % r1.returncode
    o2 = r2.stderr.decode() + r2.stdout.decode() + '[exit %d]\n' % r2.returncode
    if o1 == o2:
        print('==', nm, 'SAME'); continue
    open('/tmp/annot/_o1', 'w').write(o1); open('/tmp/annot/_o2', 'w').write(o2)
    r = subprocess.run(['diff', '/tmp/annot/_o1', '/tmp/annot/_o2'], capture_output=True)
    lines = r.stdout.decode().split('\n')
    # hide the scope hash noise
    import re
    print('==', nm, 'DIFF (%d lines)' % len(lines))
    print('\n'.join(lines[:n]))

import sys, subprocess, re, os, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/link2')
import importlib.util

MINE = '/tmp/bin-link2/executable'


def run(b, src):
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='/tmp/link2/rr.')
    open(d + '/r_in.lini', 'w').write(src)
    r = subprocess.run([b, 'r_in.lini'], capture_output=True, cwd=d)
    os.remove(d + '/r_in.lini'); os.rmdir(d)
    return r.stdout.decode(), r.stderr.decode()


def links(out):
    res = []
    cur = None
    for l in out.splitlines():
        m = re.search(r'<g class="lini-(link|stray)[^"]*"[^>]*data-from="([^"]*)" data-to="([^"]*)"', l)
        if m:
            cur = [m.group(2) + '->' + m.group(3), None]
            res.append(cur)
            continue
        m = re.search(r'<path d="([^"]*)"', l)
        if m and cur is not None and cur[1] is None:

f = sys.argv[1]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Probe participant x positions via raw tab paths: each participant gets a
# loop with a self message, whose tab path starts at x - 23.5 (+4).
import subprocess, sys, os, re, tempfile

def run(src, binp='/workspace/executable'):
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir='/tmp/seq')
    open(os.path.join(d, 'p.lini'), 'w').write(src)
    r = subprocess.run([binp, 'p.lini'], capture_output=True, cwd=d, text=True)
    subprocess.run(['rm', '-rf', d])
    return r.stdout + r.stderr

def probe(labels, extra='', binp='/workspace/executable', gap=None):
    lines = ['{ layout: sequence%s }' % ('; gap: %s' % gap if gap else '')]
    for k, l in enumerate(labels):
        lines.append('|box#p%d| "%s"' % (k, l))
    lines.append(extra)
    for k in range(len(labels)):
        lines.append('|loop| [ p%d -> p%d ]' % (k, k))
    out = run('\n'.join(lines) + '\n', binp)
    xs = []
    for m in re.finditer(r'<path d="M (\S+) (\S+) L (\S+) \S+ L \S+ \S+ L \S+ \S+ L (\S+) ', out):
        xs.append(m.group(4))
    return xs, out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    labels = sys.argv[1:]
    xs, out = probe(labels)
    print(xs)

from tw import fonts

def tws(s, size, w):
    t = fonts[w]
    advs = [t.adv[t.cmap[ord(c)]] for c in s]
    out = {}
    x = 0.0
    for a in advs: x += a / 1000 * size
    out['a/u*s'] = x
    x = 0.0
    for a in advs: x += a * size / 1000
    out['a*s/u'] = x
    out['sum*s/u'] = sum(advs) * size / 1000
    out['sum/u*s'] = sum(advs) / 1000 * size
    x = 0.0
    for a in advs: x += a * (size / 1000)
    out['a*(s/u)'] = x
    return out

def boxw(tw, k):
    if k == 0: return ((tw + 20) + 20) + 2
    if k == 1: return tw + 42
    if k == 2: return (tw + 2) + 40
    if k == 3: return tw + (20 + 20 + 2)

def curz(ws):
    c = 0.0; xs = []
    for w in ws:
        xs.append(c + w/2); c += w + g
    tot = c - g
    return [x - tot/2 for x in xs]

def curz2(ws):
    c = 0.0; xs = []
    for k, w in enumerate(ws):
        xs.append(c + w/2); c += w
        if k < len(ws) - 1: c += g
    tot = c
    return [x - tot/2 for x in xs]

def curz3(ws):
    # half-width steps
    c = 0.0; xs = []
    for k, w in enumerate(ws):
        c += w / 2
        xs.append(c)
        c += w / 2 + g
    tot = c - g
    return [x - tot/2 for x in xs]

def curz4(ws):
    c = 0.0; xs = []
    for k, w in enumerate(ws):
        if k: c += g
        xs.append(c + w/2); c += w
    return [x - c/2 for x in xs]

cases = {

}
for var in ['a/u*s', 'a*s/u', 'sum*s/u', 'sum/u*s', 'a*(s/u)']:
    for k in range(4):
        for fn in [curz, curz2, curz3, curz4]:
            res = []
            for name, (labels, exp) in cases.items():
                ws = [boxw(tws(l, 15, 500)[var], k) for l in labels]
                xs = fn(ws)
                got = [repr(x - 23.5) for x in xs]
                res.append(got == exp)
            print(var, k, fn.__name__, res)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# usage: rep.py file spec.txt
# spec.txt: blocks of "<<<<\nold\n====\nnew\n>>>>" ; each old must occur (all occurrences replaced unless prefixed '!1')
import sys, re
path, spec = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
s = open(path).read()
blocks = open(spec).read().split('<<<<\n')[1:]
for b in blocks:
    old, rest = b.split('\n====\n', 1)
    if rest.startswith('>>>>'):
        new = ''
    else:
        new = rest.rsplit('\n>>>>', 1)[0]
    once = False
    if old.startswith('!1'):
        once = True
        old = old[2:]
    n = s.count(old)
    if n == 0:
        print('NOT FOUND:', old[:80]); sys.exit(1)
    s = s.replace(old, new, 1 if once else -1)
    print('replaced %d: %s' % (1 if once else n, old.split(chr(10))[0][:70]))
open(path, 'w').write(s)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# vary the right pin's label width; report tip x and satellite offsets for a chain body
import sys, re, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/sch/scripts')
from summ import run

body = sys.argv[1].replace('\\n', '\n')
labels = sys.argv[2:]
extra = os.environ.get('EXTRA', '')
for lab in labels:
    src = ('{ layout: schematic; %s |vcc::label| { symbol: power } [ "5V" ] }\n' % extra) + \
        ('|component#u1| "U" [ |pin#a| {side: left}; |pin#b| {side: left}; |pin#c| "%s" {side: right} ]\n' % lab) + body
    o, e, c = run(src)
    u = re.search(r'data-id="u1" transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)', o)
    ux, uy = float(u.group(1)), float(u.group(2))
    ids = re.findall(r'data-id="([^"]+)" transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)', o)
    rel = []
    for i, x, y in ids:
        if i in ('a', 'b', 'c', 'u1', 'p1', 'p2', 'w', 'k', 'plus', 'minus'):
            continue
        rel.append('%s(%g,%g)' % (i, float(x) - ux, float(y) - uy))
    ls = re.findall(r'<g class="lini-link"[^>]*>\n\s*<path d="([^"]*)"', o)
    tip = None
    m = re.search(r'<g class="lini-link"[^>]*>\n\s*<path d="M ([-\d.]+) ', o)
    if m: tip = float(m.group(1)) - ux
    print('%-10s tip=%8.4f %s | %s %s' % (lab, tip if tip is not None else 0, ' '.join(rel), ' || '.join(ls), e.strip()[:60]))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# fine scan: vary right-pin label; report (tip, satellite x offsets) sorted by tip, only where the result changes
import sys, re, os, itertools
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/sch/scripts')
from summ import run

body = sys.argv[1].replace('\\n', '\n')
target = sys.argv[2]  # id whose x offset we track
extra = os.environ.get('EXTRA', '')
chars = ['i', 'l', 'c', 'x', 'm', 'W']
labels = set()
for n in range(1, 4):
    for combo in itertools.product(chars, repeat=n):
        labels.add(''.join(combo))
rows = []
for lab in sorted(labels):
    src = ('{ layout: schematic; %s |vcc::label| { symbol: power } [ "5V" ] }\n' % extra) + \
        ('|component#u1| "U" [ |pin#a| {side: left}; |pin#b| {side: left}; |pin#c| "%s" {side: right} ]\n' % lab) + body
    o, e, c = run(src)
    u = re.search(r'data-id="u1" transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)', o)
    ux = float(u.group(1))
    t = re.search(r'data-id="%s" transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)' % target, o)
    m = re.search(r'<g class="lini-link"[^>]*>\n\s*<path d="M ([-\d.]+) ', o)
    tip = float(m.group(1)) - ux
    rows.append((tip, float(t.group(1)) - ux, lab))
rows.sort()
prev = None
for tip, x, lab in rows:
    if prev is None or x != prev[1]:
        if prev: print('   last tip %.4f -> %g' % (prev[0], prev[1]))
        print('tip %.4f -> %g (%s)' % (tip, x, lab))
    prev = (tip, x, lab)
print('   last tip %.4f -> %g' % (prev[0], prev[1]))

    for needexpr in ['lw+16', '16+lw', 'lw+8+8']:

        cur = xs[1] - xs[0]
        d = need - cur
        for x1expr in ['xs[1]+d', 'xs[0]+need', '(xs[0]+need)']:
            x1 = eval(x1expr)
            for x2expr in ['xs[2]+d', 'x1+(xs[2]-xs[1])', 'x1+ws[1]/2+g+ws[2]/2', 'x1+(ws[1]/2+g)+ws[2]/2']:
                x2 = eval(x2expr)
                for totexpr in ['tot+d', 'x2+ws[2]/2', 'tot+(need-cur)']:
                    t = eval(totexpr)
                    fin = [xs[0] - t / 2, x1 - t / 2, x2 - t / 2]
                    got = [repr(v - 23.5) for v in fin]
                    flag = [got[k] == exp[k] for k in range(3)]

import sys, re, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/tree')
from lt import *
from gen import case

def f4(x):
    s = '%.4f' % x
    s = s.rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
    if s == '-0':
        s = '0'
    return s

def nums(p):
    return [float(x) for x in re.findall(r'-?[0-9.]+', p)]

rng = random.Random(7)
total = 0
fails = {}
samples = []
for i in range(40):
    src = case(rng)
    if 'mindmap' not in src:
        continue
    o, e, c = run(src)
    for p in paths(o):
        if ' C ' not in p or p.count(' C ') > 1:
            continue
        v = nums(p)
        # M sx sy L s1x s1y C c1x c1y c2x c2y e1x e1y L ex ey
        sx, sy, s1x, s1y, c1x, c1y, c2x, c2y, e1x, e1y, ex, ey = v
        samples.append((p, v))
print(len(samples))
# candidate: reconstruct from s and e (printed values are rounded!) -- s and e are exact-ish (4 dec)
import math
def cands(sx, sy, ex, ey, horiz, sgs, sge):
    # horiz: sides are left/right; sgs = start dir sign along main, sge = end dir sign
    out = {}
    if horiz:
        s1 = (sx + sgs * 2, sy); e1 = (ex + sge * 2, ey)
        dist = math.hypot(e1[0] - s1[0], e1[1] - s1[1])
        along = abs(e1[0] - s1[0])
        h = min(dist / 2, max(along, dist / 4))
        out['a'] = (s1[0] + sgs * h, s1[1], e1[0] + sge * h, e1[1])
        out['b'] = (sx + sgs * (2 + h), sy, ex + sge * (2 + h), ey)
        out['c'] = (s1[0] + sgs * h, s1[1], e1[0] - (-sge) * h, e1[1])
    return out
ok = {}
for p, v in samples:
    sx, sy, s1x, s1y, c1x, c1y, c2x, c2y, e1x, e1y, ex, ey = v
    if sy != s1y:
        continue
    sgs = 1 if s1x > sx else -1
    sge = 1 if e1x > ex else -1
    cs = cands(sx, sy, ex, ey, True, sgs, sge)
    for k, c in cs.items():
        good = f4(c[0]) == f4(c1x) and f4(c[2]) == f4(c2x)
        ok.setdefault(k, [0, 0])
        ok[k][0 if good else 1] += 1
print(ok)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# vary a satellite 2-pin component's width (via its value label); report its x offset from u1
import sys, re, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/sch/scripts')
from summ import run

extra = os.environ.get('EXTRA', '')
labs = []
for n in range(1, 40):
    labs.append('i' * n)
for n in range(1, 14):
    labs.append('W' * n)
rows = []
for lab in labs:
    src = ('{ layout: schematic; %s }\n' % extra) + \
        '|component#u1| "U" [ |pin#a| {side: left}; |pin#b| {side: left}; |pin#c| {side: right} ]\n' + \
        ('|component#s| "%s" [ |pin#p| {side: top}; |pin#q| {side: bottom} ]\n' % lab) + \
        'u1.c - s.p\ns.q - |gnd|\n'
    o, e, c = run(src)
    u = re.search(r'data-id="u1" transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)', o)
    s = re.search(r'data-id="s" transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)">\n\s*<rect x="([-\d.]+)" y="[-\d.]+" width="([-\d.]+)"', o)
    if not s:
        print(lab, 'no s', e[:100]); continue
    ux = float(u.group(1))
    sx = float(s.group(1)) - ux
    # extent of s: max of rect and value label
    m = re.search(r'data-id="s" transform[^\n]*\n(?:.*\n)*?\s*<g class="lini-node lini-part-value lini-block" transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)">\n\s*<rect x="([-\d.]+)" y="[-\d.]+" width="([-\d.]+)"', o)
    vw = float(m.group(4)) if m else 0
    rw = float(s.group(4))
    rows.append((max(vw / 2, rw / 2 + 0.75), sx, lab))
rows.sort()
prev = None
for hw, x, lab in rows:
    if prev is None or x != prev[1]:
        if prev: print('   last hw %.4f -> %g' % (prev[0], prev[1]))
        print('hw %.4f -> %g (%s)' % (hw, x, lab))
    prev = (hw, x, lab)
print('   last hw %.4f -> %g' % (prev[0], prev[1]))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# compare the scope hull with the tight extent of all drawn items (incl. wires, labels)
import sys, re, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/sch/scripts')
from summ import run

def tight(svg):
    # parse the scene: track transforms through <g> nesting; collect rect/line/path/ellipse boxes
    xs0, ys0, xs1, ys1 = [], [], [], []
    stack = [(0.0, 0.0)]
    lines = svg.split('\n')
    in_scene = False
    for l in lines:
        s = l.strip()
        if s.startswith('<g class="lini-scene">'):
            in_scene = True
            stack = [(0.0, 0.0)]
            continue
        if not in_scene:
            continue
        if s.startswith('<g class="lini-links'):
            stack = [(0.0, 0.0)]
        m = re.match(r'<g [^>]*transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)', s)
        if m:
            ox, oy = stack[-1]
            stack.append((ox + float(m.group(1)), oy + float(m.group(2))))
            continue
        if s.startswith('<g'):
            stack.append(stack[-1])
            if s.endswith('/>'):
                stack.pop()
            continue
        if s.startswith('</g>'):
            stack.pop()
            continue
        ox, oy = stack[-1]
        m = re.match(r'<rect x="([-\d.]+)" y="([-\d.]+)" width="([-\d.]+)" height="([-\d.]+)"', s)
        if m:
            x, y, w, h = map(float, m.groups())
            xs0.append(ox + x); ys0.append(oy + y); xs1.append(ox + x + w); ys1.append(oy + y + h)
        m = re.match(r'<path d="([^"]+)"', s)
        if m:
            nums = re.findall(r'-?[\d.]+', m.group(1))
            vals = [float(v) for v in nums]
            # crude: pairs
            for k in range(0, len(vals) - 1, 2):
                xs0.append(ox + vals[k]); xs1.append(ox + vals[k]); ys0.append(oy + vals[k + 1]); ys1.append(oy + vals[k + 1])
        m = re.match(r'<text class="lini-link-label" x="([-\d.]+)" y="([-\d.]+)"', s)
        if m:
            xs0.append(float(m.group(1))); xs1.append(float(m.group(1))); ys0.append(float(m.group(2)) - 5.5); ys1.append(float(m.group(2)) + 5.5)
    return min(xs0), min(ys0), max(xs1), max(ys1)

for arg in sys.argv[1:]:
    src = open(arg).read() if os.path.exists(arg) else arg.replace('\\n', '\n')
    o, e, c = run(src)
    vb = [float(v) for v in re.search(r'viewBox="([^"]+)"', o).group(1).split()]
    hx = -vb[0] - 40; hy = -vb[1] - 40
    t = tight(o)
    print('%s\n   hull %.4f %.4f | tight x[%.4f, %.4f] y[%.4f, %.4f] | dx %.4f dy %.4f' % (arg[:60].replace('\n', ' '), hx, hy, t[0], t[2], t[1], t[3], hx - max(-t[0], t[2]), hy - max(-t[1], t[3])))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# hull vs tight while varying the left pin label of u1; body given as argv[1] (uses u1.c on the right)
import sys, re, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/sch/scripts')
from summ import run
sys.argv.pop(0)
from hull import tight

body = sys.argv[0].replace('\\n', '\n')
labs = sys.argv[1:] or ['a', 'aa', 'aaa', 'aaaa', 'aaaaa', 'aaaaaa', 'aaaaaaa', 'aaaaaaaa']
for lab in labs:
    src = '{ layout: schematic; %s }\n' % os.environ.get('EXTRA', '') + \
        '|component#u1| "U" [ |pin#a| "%s" {side: left}; |pin#b| {side: left}; |pin#c| {side: right} ]\n' % lab + body
    o, e, c = run(src)
    vb = [float(v) for v in re.search(r'viewBox="([^"]+)"', o).group(1).split()]
    hx = -vb[0] - 40; hy = -vb[1] - 40
    t = tight(o)
    u = re.search(r'data-id="u1" transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)', o)
    print('%-9s u1@%s,%s hull %.4f %.4f | tight x[%.4f, %.4f] y[%.4f, %.4f]' % (lab, u.group(1), u.group(2), hx, hy, t[0], t[2], t[1], t[3]))

from e9 import *
import itertools

rng = random.Random(3)
done = 0
for i in range(60):
    src = case(rng)
    if 'mindmap' not in src:
        continue
    o, e, c = run(src)
    ps = paths(o)
    ds = dbg(src)
    if len(ps) != len(ds):
        continue
    for p, d in zip(ps, ds):
        if p.count(' C ') != 1:
            continue
        got = fmt(curve(side_pt(d['from'], d['sa'], 'bu'), side_pt(d['to'], d['sb'], 'bu'), d['sa'], d['sb']))
        if got != p and done < 3:
            done += 1
            print('ORIG', p)
            print('to chain', d['to'], d['sb'])
            ch = d['to']
            xs = [c[0] for c in ch]
            w = ch[0][2]
            sgn = 1 if d['sb'] == 'Right' else -1
            # candidates
            bu = 0.0
            for v in xs: bu += v
            td = 0.0
            for v in reversed(xs): td += v
            print(' bu+w/2', repr(bu + sgn * w / 2), f4(bu + sgn * w / 2))
            print(' td+w/2', repr(td + sgn * w / 2), f4(td + sgn * w / 2))
            # leaf edge first then add parents bottom-up
            t = xs[0] + sgn * w / 2
            for v in xs[1:]: t += v
            print(' leaf-edge bu', repr(t), f4(t))
            t = 0.0
            for v in reversed(xs[1:]): t += v
            t2 = t + (xs[0] + sgn * w / 2)
            print(' parents td + leaf edge', repr(t2), f4(t2))
            t = 0.0
            for v in reversed(xs[1:]): t += v
            t3 = (t + xs[0]) + sgn * w / 2
            print(' td', repr(t3), f4(t3))
