#!/usr/bin/env python3
# bridges.py files... : for every bridge we plan, the original's first-part offset and anchor pitch vs ours
import sys, os, subprocess, re
def tops(svg):
    out = {}
    for m in re.finditer(r'<g class="lini-node ([^"]*)" data-id="([^"]*)" transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)">', svg):
        out.setdefault(m.group(2), (float(m.group(3)), float(m.group(4))))
    return out
for f in sys.argv[1:]:
    d = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(f)); b = os.path.basename(f)
    env = dict(os.environ, LINI_SCH_DBG='1')
    r = subprocess.run(['/tmp/bin-sch/executable', b], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    lines = [l for l in r.stderr.split('\n') if l.startswith('bridge ')]
    if not lines:
        continue
    o = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', b], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    m = r.stdout
    to, tm = tops(o), tops(m)
    for l in lines:
        w = l.split()
        a, bb, parts = w[1], w[2], w[3].split(',')
        kv = dict(zip(w[4::2], w[5::2]))
        if a not in to or bb not in to or parts[0] not in to:
            continue
        oa, ob, op = to[a], to[bb], to[parts[0]]
        ma, mb, mp = tm.get(a), tm.get(bb), tm.get(parts[0])
        ofirst = abs(op[0] - oa[0]); opitch = abs(ob[0] - oa[0])
        mfirst = abs(mp[0] - ma[0]) if mp else None; mpitch = abs(mb[0] - ma[0]) if mb else None
        flag = '' if (ofirst == mfirst and opitch == mpitch) else '  <<<'
        print('%s %s-%s %s first o%g m%s pitch o%g m%s | na %.3f nb %.3f span %s tail %s need %s gap %s hl %s%s' % (
            b, a, bb, ','.join(parts), ofirst, mfirst, opitch, mpitch, float(kv['near_a']), float(kv['near_b']), kv['span'], kv['tail'], kv['need'], kv['gap'], kv['hl'], flag))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# genstyle.py N SEED : flow documents with random generic (valid) styles
import random, sys
n=int(sys.argv[1]); random.seed(int(sys.argv[2]))
vals={
 'fill':['red','--sky','#abc','white','none','rgb(10, 20, 30)','--teal-wash','light-dark(#111, #eee)','gradient(--sky, --teal)'],
 'stroke':['blue','--rose','none','#123456','--stroke'],
 'stroke-width':['1','3','0.5','4'],
 'stroke-style':['dashed','dotted','solid','center','phantom'],
 'opacity':['0.5','1','0.25'],
 'color':['red','--fg','#333','white'],
 'font-size':['10','18','24'],
 'font-weight':['bold','normal','600','semibold','medium'],
 'font-style':['italic','normal'],
 'text-decoration':['underline','line-through','none'],
 'radius':['0','4','12'],
 'padding':['0','10','5 20','1 2 3 4'],
 'shadow':['2 3 4','1 1 2 --rose','3','0 4 8 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)'],
 'width':['80','120'],
 'height':['40','60'],
 'align':['start','end','center'],
 'justify':['start','end','center'],
 'text-shadow':['1 1 2 black','0 0 3 --sky'],
 'letter-spacing':['1','2'],
 'line-spacing':['1.2','1.5'],
 'text-transform':['uppercase','lowercase','capitalize'],
 'gap':['4','20','4 8'],
 'direction':['row','column'],
}
keys=list(vals)
def style(k):
    ps=random.sample(keys,k)
    return '; '.join('%s: %s'%(p,random.choice(vals[p])) for p in ps)
out=[]
for _ in range(n):
    lines=[]
    if random.random()<0.4:
        sheet=[]
        if random.random()<0.5: sheet.append('.c { %s }'%style(random.randint(1,3)))
        if random.random()<0.5: sheet.append('|box| { %s }'%style(random.randint(1,2)))
        if random.random()<0.3: sheet.append('|oval| { %s }'%style(1))
        if random.random()<0.3: sheet.append('--mine: %s;'%random.choice(['#345','teal','light-dark(red, blue)']))
        if sheet: lines.append('{ '+'\n  '.join(sheet)+' }')
    for i in range(random.randint(1,3)):
        t=random.choice(['box','oval','box','group'])
        lbl=random.choice(['"Hello"','"Two words"','"Line one\\nline two"',''])
        cls=' .c' if random.random()<0.3 else ''
        st=' { %s }'%style(random.randint(1,4)) if random.random()<0.8 else ''
        kids=''
        if t=='group' or random.random()<0.2:
            kids=' [ |box| "k" { %s }; "t" ]'%style(1)
        lines.append('|%s#n%d| %s%s%s%s'%(t,i,lbl,cls,st,kids))
    if random.random()<0.3:
        lines.append('"free" { %s }'%random.choice(['color: red','font-size: 20','font-weight: bold','text-decoration: underline']))
    out.append('\n'.join(lines))
print('\n----\n'.join(out))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# genstyle2.py N SEED : nested flow documents over many node types with generic styles
import random, sys
n=int(sys.argv[1]); random.seed(int(sys.argv[2]))
types=['box','oval','hex','cyl','diamond','slant','group','note','badge','caption','footnote','block']
vals={
 'fill':['red','--sky','#abc','none','--teal-wash'],
 'stroke':['blue','--rose','none'],
 'stroke-width':['1','3'],
 'stroke-style':['dashed','dotted'],
 'opacity':['0.5'],
 'color':['red','--fg'],
 'font-size':['10','18'],
 'font-weight':['bold','normal'],
 'radius':['0','12'],
 'padding':['0','8','5 20'],
 'shadow':['2 3 4','3'],
 'width':['80','160'],
 'height':['40','90'],
 'align':['start','end'],
 'justify':['start','end'],
 'gap':['4','20'],
 'direction':['row','column'],
 'max-width':['100','140'],
 'text-wrap':['nowrap'],
 'translate':['5 5','-10 0'],
 'skew':['10','25'],
}
keys=list(vals)
def style(k):
    ps=random.sample(keys,k)
    return '; '.join('%s: %s'%(p,random.choice(vals[p])) for p in ps)
labels=['"Hi"','"Two words"','"A much longer label that might wrap around"','"L1\\nL2"','']
def node(d):
    t=random.choice(types)
    s='|%s|'%t
    lbl=random.choice(labels)
    if lbl: s+=' '+lbl
    if random.random()<0.6: s+=' { %s }'%style(random.randint(1,3))
    if d<2 and t not in ('badge','caption','footnote') and random.random()<0.4:
        kids=[node(d+1) for _ in range(random.randint(1,3))]
        if random.random()<0.3: kids.append(random.choice(labels[:4]))
        kids=[k for k in kids if k]
        if kids: s+=' [ '+'; '.join(kids)+' ]'
    return s
out=[]
for _ in range(n):
    lines=[]
    if random.random()<0.3:
        lines.append('{ %s; }'%random.choice(['direction: row','gap: 30','padding: 5','font-size: 13','align: start']))
    for _ in range(random.randint(1,3)):
        lines.append(node(0))
    out.append('\n'.join(lines))
print('\n----\n'.join(out))

# generate drawing variants into /tmp/annot/v/m1.lini
import itertools, random
random.seed(1)
out = []
base = '''{{ layout: drawing; }}
|rect#plate| {{ width: {w}; height: {h}; }} [
  |hole#pin| {{ width: {d}; translate: {x} {y}; pattern: grid({n}, 1, {sx}, 0); }}
]
'''
stmts = [
    'plate:left (-) plate:right {{ side: {s1}; }}',
    'plate:top (-) plate:bottom {{ side: {s2}; }}',
    'plate:left (-) plate.pin {{ side: {s1}; }}',
    'plate.pin (o) {{ side: {s3}; }}',
    'plate.pin.{k} <- "THRU" {{ side: {s3}; }}',
    'plate:top-left (-) plate:bottom-right',
    'plate:top (-) plate:bottom {{ side: {s2}; tol: {tol}; }}',
    'plate:left (-) plate:right {{ side: {s1}; format: decimal 1; }}',
    'plate.pin.1 (-) plate.pin.{k} {{ side: {s1}; }}',
    'plate:left (-) plate.pin.1 (-) plate.pin.{k} (-) plate:right {{ side: {s1}; }}',
    'plate:bottom >- "A"',
    'plate:left *- "Ra 3.2" {{ side: {s3}; }}',
]
tols = ['0.1', '0.2 -0.05', 'h6', '+0.1 0', '0.05']
for t in range(60):

    h = random.choice([30, 40, 70])
    d = random.choice([6, 8, 10, 12])
    n = random.choice([1, 2, 3])
    sx = random.choice([20, 30, 40])
    x = -((n - 1) * sx) / 2
    y = random.choice([-10, 0, 10])
    k = random.randint(1, n)
    vals = dict(w=w, h=h, d=d, n=n, sx=sx, x=x, y=y, k=k,

    chosen = random.sample(stmts, random.randint(1, 4))

    out.append(src)
open('/tmp/annot/v/m1.lini', 'w').write('\n----\n'.join(out))
print(len(out))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# usage: show.py file N [maxlines] -> print snippet N source and the diff (scene part)
import subprocess, sys, re, os, tempfile
fn, n = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2])
mx = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 40
src = open(fn).read()
snips = [s.strip('\n') for s in re.split(r'^----.*$', src, flags=re.M)]
s = snips[n]
print(s)
print('-----')
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='s_', dir='/tmp/annot')
open(os.path.join(d, 'r_in.lini'), 'w').write(s)
a = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'r_in.lini'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=d)
b = subprocess.run(['/tmp/bin-annot/executable', 'r_in.lini'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=d)
open(os.path.join(d, 'a.svg'), 'w').write(a.stdout + a.stderr)
open(os.path.join(d, 'b.svg'), 'w').write(b.stdout + b.stderr)
r = subprocess.run(['diff', os.path.join(d, 'a.svg'), os.path.join(d, 'b.svg')], capture_output=True, text=True)
lines = [l for l in r.stdout.split('\n') if 'lini-scope' not in l or l.startswith(('<svg', '> <svg', '< <svg'))]
print('\n'.join(lines[:mx]))
subprocess.run(['rm', '-rf', d])

# vsenv.py ENVSPEC files... : pass count of /tmp/bin-sch/executable with env var settings (k=v;k=v)

import sys, os, subprocess, hashlib
spec = sys.argv[1]
env = dict(os.environ)
for kv in spec.split(';'):
    if '=' in kv:
        k, v = kv.split('=', 1)
        env[k] = v
cache = '/tmp/sch/origcache'
os.makedirs(cache, exist_ok=True)
ok = 0; fails = []
for f in sys.argv[2:]:
    d = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(f)); b = os.path.basename(f)
    src = open(f, 'rb').read()
    h = hashlib.sha1(src + f.encode()).hexdigest()
    cp = os.path.join(cache, h)
    if os.path.exists(cp + '.out'):
        o1 = open(cp + '.out', 'rb').read(); e1 = open(cp + '.err', 'rb').read()
    else:
        r1 = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', b], capture_output=True, cwd=d)
        o1, e1 = r1.stdout, r1.stderr
        open(cp + '.out', 'wb').write(o1); open(cp + '.err', 'wb').write(e1)
    r2 = subprocess.run(['/tmp/bin-sch/executable', b], capture_output=True, cwd=d, env=env)
    if o1 == r2.stdout and e1 == r2.stderr:
        ok += 1
    else:
        fails.append(b)
print(spec, ok, len(sys.argv) - 2)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# bgtest.py FILE TEXT : the net name's x for body margins
import sys, os, subprocess, re
f, text = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
d = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(f)); b = os.path.basename(f)
o = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', b], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
m = re.search(r'x="([-\d.]+)" y="([-\d.]+)" dy="0.358em">%s</text>' % re.escape(text), o)
print('orig', m.groups() if m else None)
for bu in ['0', '1']:
    for g in ['0', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '8', '10', '11.5', '21.5']:
        env = dict(os.environ, LINI_SCH_BG=g, LINI_SCH_BU=bu)
        out = subprocess.run(['/tmp/bin-sch/executable', b], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env).stdout
        m = re.search(r'x="([-\d.]+)" y="([-\d.]+)" dy="0.358em">%s</text>' % re.escape(text), out)
        print('union' if bu == '1' else 'sep', g, m.groups() if m else None)

steps.message:
My work on paint, generic validation and the CLI rendering modes is committed on `worktree-agent-aa2d1b2e37fcac1a7`, and nothing regressed in any mode. The asset pass counts did not go up in this last stretch: the fixes cover behaviour the assets don't exercise, which I found with randomized comparisons against the original binary.

**Asset pass counts (246 files)**

| Mode | Pass |
|---|---|
| default | 174 |
| `--static` | 174 |
| `--embed-font` | 174 |
| `--theme dark` | 174 |
| `--theme high-contrast` | 174 |
| `--theme light/dark` | 174 |
| `--json` | 214 |
| `desugar`, `fmt --stdout`, `highlight` | 246 each |

Other checks against the original:
- **Error corpora (JSON):** `bulk_e` 800/800, suggestions 880/880, my own corpus 329/342, older generated sets about 99.5%. A new R-phase multi-error corpus scores 1997/2000; the three misses are documents with infinite sizes (see gaps).
- **Generated documents:** statement-level errors 2000/2000, layout errors 1500/1500, grids 1000/1000, gradients 1500/1500 (also clean under `--static`, `--embed-font` and dark), styles 1500/1500 in three sets, text 1199/1200.
- **CLI, theme files and odd input bytes:** 30/30, 30/30, 56/56, 45/45, 17/17.

**What this session added**
- **Descendant rules** (`|A| |B|`, `|box| .c`, `#a |oval|`, `… |-|`): two plain types become a real CSS rule; other shapes are applied inline. Unknown types in selectors are reported.
- **Gradients and shadows:** gradient and shadow defs are emitted in the original's order. In `--static`, an inline value that equals the rule once variables are baked is dropped.
- **Error ordering, so the first reported error matches the original:**
  - Statement checks: a container's nodes are checked before its links.
  - "Auto-creates a new box; did you mean …" warnings now come out of validation, so they still appear in JSON when a later error stops the run.
  - Resolve-phase order: variables, then type rules in stylesheet order (merged over the type's defaults), then other rules as written, then the root block.
  - Layout checks follow one children-first walk.
- **New errors:** duplicate and built-in-shadowing type definitions; a non-text child wider than its box's `max-width`, and `nowrap` text that cannot fit; grid track syntax; `radius` on slant/hex/diamond.
- **Cascade and layout fixes:** several classes on one node now apply in stylesheet order (two rules for the same class both apply). Also fixed: dash patterns, how pinned children are placed, cylinders, empty paths, and text wrapping on tabs and no-break spaces.
- **Root block, theme files and input:** a root `font-family`, `font-weight` or `color` now feeds the base text rules. Theme-file values are normalised like the original's. `--static` and `--embed-font` pick font weights from the default palette, not the theme file. A leading byte-order mark is accepted.

**Shared files I edited:** `scene.rs`, `compile.rs`, `render.rs`, `layout.rs`, `links.rs`, `table.rs`, `main.rs`, `lexer.rs`, `diag.rs`, `parser.rs`. My own modules are `paint.rs`, `outline.rs`, `validate.rs`, `theme.rs` and the new `scoped.rs`. Two things matter when merging:
- **`table.rs`:** its grid checks now run from my layout pass rather than after rendering.
- **`links.rs`:** has small additions (descendant link rules, class dash patterns, class order). These may conflict with the links agent's branch, which is still running.

**Known gaps, mostly other families' areas**
- The `|note|` type: the original draws a folded-corner shape; we draw a plain box.
- Links: link label font size (9.5333px when the root font is 13) and routing.
- Membership errors for schematic, sequence, floorplan and tree.
- Hatch fills and `pattern:`.
- `columns: left` on a `|title-block|` with no children gets no "a track is a size…" error.
- `linear-gradient((nope), …)`: our error is "invalid color" where the original reports an unknown name.
- Last-digit rounding of glyph positions at fractional font sizes.
- Infinite sizes such as `width: (1 / 0)` crash both binaries; the crash text can never match because it contains a thread id.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# for failing cases: the differing wire paths (orig / mine), compact
import sys, os, subprocess, re
for f in sys.argv[1:]:
    d = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(f)); b = os.path.basename(f)
    o = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', b], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    m = subprocess.run(['/tmp/bin-sch/executable', b], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    if o == m:
        continue
    wo = re.findall(r'data-from="([^"]+)" data-to="([^"]+)">\s*<path d="([^"]+)"', o)
    wm = re.findall(r'data-from="([^"]+)" data-to="([^"]+)">\s*<path d="([^"]+)"', m)
    diffs = [(a, c) for a, c in zip(wo, wm) if a != c]
    if not diffs:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# turned-part variants: revolve, fillets, threads, stations
import random
random.seed(7)
out = []
for t in range(40):
    r1 = random.choice([6, 8, 10, 12])
    r2 = random.choice([4, 5, 6])
    l1 = random.choice([20, 30, 40])
    l2 = random.choice([15, 20, 25])
    f = random.choice(['', ' fillet(2):r1', ' fillet(3):r1'])
    draw = 'move(-%d, 0) up(%d) right(%d):neck%s up(%d) right(%d):collar down(%d) down(%d)' % (
        (l1 + l2) // 2, r2, l1, f, r1 - r2, l2, r1 - r2, r2)
    th = random.choice(['', ' thread: neck 1.25;'])
    src = '{ layout: drawing; }\n|sketch#body| { draw: %s; revolve: x-axis;%s }\n' % (draw, th)
    stmts = [
        'body:left (-) body:right { side: bottom; }',
        'body:neck (o) { side: %s; }' % random.choice(['left', 'right']),
        'body:collar (o) { side: %s; tol: %s; }' % (random.choice(['left', 'right']), random.choice(['h6', '0.1', '0.1 -0.2'])),
        'body:neck <- "%s" { side: top; }' % random.choice(['M8', 'KNURL']),
        'body:collar (-) body:neck { side: top; }',
    ]
    if 'fillet' in f:
        stmts.append('body:r1 (o)')
    if th:
        stmts.append('body:neck <-')
    chosen = random.sample(stmts, random.randint(1, min(4, len(stmts))))
    out.append(src + '\n'.join(chosen) + '\n')
open('/tmp/annot/v/m2.lini', 'w').write('\n----\n'.join(out))
print(len(out))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import random
random.seed(11)
chars = ['straightness', 'flatness', 'circularity', 'cylindricity', 'profile-line', 'profile-surface',
         'angularity', 'perpendicularity', 'parallelism', 'position', 'concentricity', 'symmetry',
         'circular-runout', 'total-runout']
needs = ['angularity', 'perpendicularity', 'parallelism', 'concentricity', 'symmetry', 'circular-runout', 'total-runout']
form = ['straightness', 'flatness', 'circularity', 'cylindricity']
out = []
for t in range(50):
    c = random.choice(chars)
    props = ['characteristic: %s' % c, 'tol: %s' % random.choice(['0.1', '0.05', '0.25', '1', '0.008'])]
    if random.random() < 0.4:
        props.append('zone: %s' % random.choice(['diameter', 'spherical']))
    if random.random() < 0.3:
        props.append('material: %s' % random.choice(['maximum', 'least']))
    if random.random() < 0.2:
        props.append('modifiers: %s' % random.choice(['free-state', 'tangent-plane', 'projected 12']))
    if c not in form and (c in needs or random.random() < 0.5):
        k = random.randint(1, 3)
        ds = ['A', 'B', 'C'][:k]
        ds = [d + (' maximum' if random.random() < 0.2 else '') for d in ds]
        props.append('datums: ' + ', '.join(ds))
    place = random.choice(['translate: 0 %d' % random.choice([30, 40, -40]), 'seat'])
    src = '{ layout: drawing; }\n|rect#plate| { width: 80; height: 40; }\nplate:bottom >- "A"\nplate:left >- "B"\nplate:right >- "C"\n'
    if place == 'seat':
        src += '|feature-control#fc| { %s; }\nfc || plate:top\n' % '; '.join(props)
    else:
        src += '|feature-control| { %s; %s; }\n' % ('; '.join(props), place)
    out.append(src)
# composite frames
for t in range(10):
    rows = []
    for r in range(random.randint(2, 3)):
        c = random.choice(['position', 'flatness', 'perpendicularity', 'profile-surface'])
        p = ['tol: %s' % random.choice(['0.1', '0.4', '0.05'])]
        if c in needs or c == 'position':
            p.append('datums: ' + random.choice(['A', 'A, B', 'A, B, C']))
        if c == 'position' and random.random() < 0.5:
            p.append('zone: diameter')
        rows.append('|control| "%s" { %s; }' % (c, '; '.join(p)))
    src = '{ layout: drawing; }\n|rect#plate| { width: 80; height: 40; }\nplate:bottom >- "A"\nplate:left >- "B"\nplate:right >- "C"\n'
    src += '|feature-control| { translate: 0 -40; } [\n  ' + '\n  '.join(rows) + '\n]\n'
    out.append(src)
open('/tmp/annot/v/m3.lini', 'w').write('\n----\n'.join(out))
print(len(out))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# usage: errs.py file -> per snippet: the original's first error line (or OK), and whether ours matches
import subprocess, sys, re, os, tempfile
fn = sys.argv[1]
src = open(fn).read()
snips = [s.strip('\n') for s in re.split(r'^----.*$', src, flags=re.M)]
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='e_', dir='/tmp/annot')
for k, s in enumerate(snips):
    open(os.path.join(d, 'r_in.lini'), 'w').write(s)
    a = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'r_in.lini'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=d)
    b = subprocess.run(['/tmp/bin-annot/executable', 'r_in.lini'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=d)
    same = a.stdout == b.stdout and a.stderr == b.stderr and a.returncode == b.returncode
    first = (a.stderr.strip().split('\n')[0] if a.returncode else 'OK')
    head = s.strip().split('\n')[-1][:70]
    print('%2d %s | %s | %s' % (k, 'SAME' if same else 'DIFF', head, first.replace('r_in.lini:', '')))
subprocess.run(['rm', '-rf', d])

    hx = random.choice(['-15 -10', '0 0', '-15 0'])
    fill = random.choice(['', ' fill: hatch(45, 6);', ' fill: hatch(-45, 4);'])
    src = '|drawing#v| "VIEW"%s {%s } [\n  |rect#plate| { width: 80; height: 50;%s } [\n    |hole#h| { width: 6; translate: %s; pattern: %s; }\n  ]\n' % (

        elif kind == 'vert':
            stmts.append('plate:top (-) plate:bottom { side: %s; }' % random.choice(['left', 'right']))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# region.py FILE x0 y0 x1 y1 : top-level nodes (and their rects) of the original output overlapping a region
import sys, os, subprocess, re
f = sys.argv[1]; x0, y0, x1, y1 = map(float, sys.argv[2:6])
d = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(f)); b = os.path.basename(f)
o = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', b], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
# walk with a translate stack
stack = []
for line in o.split('\n'):
    s = line.strip()
    m = re.match(r'<g class="([^"]*)"(?: data-id="([^"]*)")? transform="translate\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)">', s)
    if m:
        px, py = stack[-1][1] if stack else (0.0, 0.0)
        stack.append((m.group(2) or m.group(1).split()[1] if len(m.group(1).split()) > 1 else m.group(1), (px + float(m.group(3)), py + float(m.group(4)))))
        continue
    if s.startswith('<g'):
        stack.append(('', stack[-1][1] if stack else (0.0, 0.0)))
        continue
    if s == '</g>':
        if stack:
            stack.pop()
        continue
    m = re.match(r'<rect x="([-\d.]+)" y="([-\d.]+)" width="([-\d.]+)" height="([-\d.]+)"', s)
    if m and stack:
        ox, oy = stack[-1][1]
        rx, ry, rw, rh = map(float, m.groups())
        a = (ox + rx, oy + ry, ox + rx + rw, oy + ry + rh)
        if a[0] < x1 and a[2] > x0 and a[1] < y1 and a[3] > y0:
            print('%-30s [%.2f %.2f %.2f %.2f]' % ('/'.join(n for n, _ in stack if n)[-60:], *a))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import random
random.seed(71)
out = []
for t in range(30):
    a = random.choice([(10, -10), (20, -5), (5, -20), (15, 0), (0, -15), (-10, -10)])

    stmts = []
    pairs = [('flank', 'base'), ('base', 'flank'), ('post', 'flank'), ('flank', 'top'), ('top', 'post'), ('base', 'close')]
    for k in range(random.randint(1, 2)):
        p = random.choice(pairs)
        fmt = random.choice(['', ' { format: decimal 1; }', ' { format: decimal 0; }'])
        stmts.append('s:%s (<) s:%s%s' % (p[0], p[1], fmt))
    out.append(src + '\n'.join(stmts) + '\n')
open('/tmp/annot/v/m9.lini', 'w').write('\n----\n'.join(out))
print(len(out))

        '[ |surface-finish| "Ra 1.6" ]',

    src = '{ layout: drawing; }\n|rect#plate| { width: 60; height: 40; } [ |hole#pin| { width: 10; translate: %d 0; } ]\nplate:bottom >- "A"\n' % random.choice([-10, 0, 10])
    if which == 'h':
        src += 'plate:left (-) plate:right { side: %s; } %s\n' % (side, carried)
    elif which == 'v':
        src += 'plate:top (-) plate:bottom { side: %s; } %s\n' % (vside, carried)
    else:
        src += 'plate.pin (o) %s\n' % carried
    if random.random() < 0.5:
        src += 'plate:left (-) plate.pin { side: %s; }\n' % side
    out.append(src)
open('/tmp/annot/v/m10.lini', 'w').write('\n----\n'.join(out))

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Pipeline: parse → build_sheet → Builder (build_stmts, icon::validate, annot::detail_views [datum_duplicates first], resolve_links [annot::check_stmt hook]) → compute → drawing::expand (check_frames → resolve phase → chart::validate_placement → layout loop per node: chart::points_check, scale check, annot::node_check, geometry-child check with annot::not_geometry …) → chart::validate → prepare → layout::measure (annot::layout per drawing frame) → annot::check → links → render (annot::render).
   - Halos: hits per outline edge; edge-end hits need company (another hit at same t) ("pairing rule"); tangent (sin<1e-4) skipped; drop flags: crossing exactly at own tip or halo touching own arrowhead box; other items' arrowhead boxes; exact other tips; ext-line stub (halo near end within EXT_GAP of line start); merged segments inherit drop; notes and annotation nodes excluded; clip wrapper box excluded but clipped copies included; rings excluded.

   - Dimension rows: band extents (alo/ahi along axis incl. text) for packing and base; new row near = max(last row far, base) + CLEAR; tol stack texts only affect far edge (smax), not smin; aligned dims: side left/right of first→second, default away from geometry-box centre (tie → text side), offset CLEAR+ARROW_HW (20) or CLEAR+TEXT_OFF+half_h (32 when text between), push to clear earlier bands (oriented polygons, slab-clipped, collision test), aligned band pushed to lay.obstacles (AABB) and lay.bands (oriented).

#!/bin/bash
# a tag on a pin that also has a tie: where does it go?
cd /tmp/sch
B='|component#U2| { cell: 2 1; } [ |pin#S| { side: left; } ]'
run() {
  python3 scripts/mk.py t10 tg "$1"
  echo "== $2"
  ( cd t10 && /workspace/executable tg.lini 2>&1 >/dev/null | sed 's/^/   W /' )
  python3 scripts/summ.py -d 2 t10/tg.lini | grep -E "block#U|label|<path" | sed 's/^/   /'
  python3 scripts/summ.py -m -d 2 t10/tg.lini | grep -E "label" | sed 's/^/   M /'
}
run "|component#U1| { cell: 1 1; } [ |pin#P| { side: right; } ];;$B;;U1.P -> \"TAG\";;U1.P - U2.S" "1 pin"
run "|component#U1| { cell: 1 1; } [ |pin#P| { side: right; }; |pin#Q| { side: right; } ];;$B;;U1.P -> \"TAG\";;U1.P - U2.S" "P of P,Q"
run "|component#U1| { cell: 1 1; } [ |pin#Q| { side: right; }; |pin#P| { side: right; } ];;$B;;U1.P -> \"TAG\";;U1.P - U2.S" "P of Q,P"
run "|component#U1| { cell: 1 1; } [ |pin#P| { side: right; }; |pin#G| { side: bottom; } ];;$B;;U1.P -> \"TAG\";;U1.P - U2.S" "P + bottom pin"
run "|component#U1| { cell: 1 1; } [ |pin#P| { side: right; } ];;$B;;U1.P - U2.S;;U1.P -> \"TAG\"" "1 pin, tie first"
run "|component#U1| { cell: 1 1; } [ |pin#P| { side: right; } ];;$B;;U1.P - \"NET\";;U1.P - U2.S" "1 pin, net label"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# usage: reg.py OLD_BIN NEW_BIN files... -> per snippet: regressions (old SAME, new DIFF) and fixes
import subprocess, sys, os, tempfile, re
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
ORIG = '/workspace/executable'
old, new = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
files = sys.argv[3:]
def run(b, s):
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='g_', dir='/tmp/annot')
    open(os.path.join(d, 'r_in.lini'), 'w').write(s)
    try:
        r = subprocess.run([b, 'r_in.lini'], capture_output=True, cwd=d, timeout=30)
        res = (r.stdout, r.stderr, r.returncode)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        res = ('timeout',)
    subprocess.run(['rm', '-rf', d])
    return res
jobs = []
for fn in files:
    src = open(fn).read()
    snips = [s.strip('\n') for s in re.split(r'^----.*$', src, flags=re.M)]
    for k, s in enumerate(snips):
        if s.strip():
            jobs.append((fn, k, s))
def one(j):
    fn, k, s = j
    o = run(ORIG, s)
    return (fn, k, run(old, s) == o, run(new, s) == o)
with ThreadPoolExecutor(16) as ex:
    res = list(ex.map(one, jobs))
reg = [(f, k) for f, k, a, b in res if a and not b]
fix = [(f, k) for f, k, a, b in res if b and not a]
print('total', len(res), 'old same', sum(1 for r in res if r[2]), 'new same', sum(1 for r in res if r[3]))
print('REGRESSIONS', len(reg))
for f, k in reg:
    print('  ', os.path.basename(f), k)
print('FIXES', len(fix))
for f, k in fix:
    print('  ', os.path.basename(f), k)

    src = open(fn).read()
    snips = [s.strip('\n') for s in re.split(r'^----.*$', src, flags=re.M)]
    for k, s in enumerate(snips):
        if s.strip():
            jobs.append((fn, k, s))
def one(j):
    fn, k, s = j
    o = run(ORIG, s)
    return (fn, k, run(old, s) == o, run(new, s) == o)
with ThreadPoolExecutor(16) as ex:
    res = list(ex.map(one, jobs))
reg = [(f, k) for f, k, a, b in res if a and not b]
fix = [(f, k) for f, k, a, b in res if b and not a]
print('total', len(res), 'old same', sum(1 for r in res if r[2]), 'new same', sum(1 for r in res if r[3]))
print('REGRESSIONS', len(reg))
for f, k in reg:

print('FIXES', len(fix))
for f, k in fix:

# Lini reimplementation — notes for contributors

## The task (read carefully)
We are reimplementing, from scratch in Rust (std only, no crates), a closed binary at
`/workspace/executable` ("lini 1.1.0", a diagram compiler: Lini source → SVG). Our build must
produce byte-identical stdout/stderr/exit codes for every input. Hidden tests compare outputs
exactly, so a test only passes when the whole output matches.

RULES (strict):
- Learn behaviour ONLY by running `/workspace/executable` with inputs and reading its output.
  NEVER decompile/disassemble it, never use strace/ltrace/gdb on it, never read its bytes.
- No internet, no looking for lini source code anywhere. std-only Rust.
- Do not run `./compile.sh` in /workspace (it would try to overwrite the original binary).
- Keep scratch scripts OUTSIDE the repo (e.g. /tmp/<you>/). Non-Rust code in the repo is limited.

- NEVER run `executable fmt FILE` (without --stdout) or our fmt on files inside /workspace —
  fmt rewrites files in place. Copy inputs to /tmp/<you>/ first if you need in-place commands.
- Do NOT use `executable serve` or anything it serves over HTTP. Stick to the CLI
  (compile, --json, --static, --embed-font, desugar, fmt, highlight, theme) as your oracle.

## Docs / samples
- `/workspace/README.md` (overview), `/workspace/assets/` — sample inputs:
  `test_doc_examples/*.lini` (one per documented property, plus SPEC/SKILL snippets),
  `test_samples/*.lini` (larger feature boards), `test_images/mark.png`.
  The hidden test-suite is very likely more files of the same kinds.

## Build & compare
- In your checkout: `cargo build --release` → `target/release/lini`.
- Copy it to a private dir under the name `executable` (help/usage text uses argv[0]):
  `mkdir -p /tmp/bin-<you> && cp target/release/lini /tmp/bin-<you>/executable`
- Tools in `/tmp/agent-tools/` (shared, read-only use):
  - `cmpw.py /tmp/bin-<you>/executable [-a "args"] files...` → OK n / m and failing files.
  - `dw /tmp/bin-<you>/executable file.lini [args]` → diff (original vs ours).
  - `rr 'lini source' [args]` → run the ORIGINAL on a snippet (prints output + [exit N]).
  - `rm2 /tmp/bin-<you>/executable 'lini source' [args]` → diff on a snippet.
- Font metric helper (python, for exploration): `/tmp/scripts/tw.py` / `/tmp/scripts/ttf.py`.

## Code map (src/)
- `main.rs` — CLI dispatch (`cli.rs` emulates clap), `compile_src()` pipeline:
  parse → `scene::build_sheet` → `scene::Builder` (node tree) → `compile::compute` (cascade +
  `Computed` per node) → `layout::measure(ctx, 0, None)` → `render::render`.
- `lexer.rs`, `parser.rs`, `ast.rs` — tokens / recursive descent / syntax tree. Errors are
  fail-fast: first `Diag` aborts (`diag.rs` has codes & text/JSON rendering).
- `scene.rs` — `SheetModel` (root config decls, vars, bindings, type rules, defines, classes,
  id rules, link rules), `Node` (prim, `chain` = type chain most-derived first, id, classes,
  inline decls, text, children, `props` = cascaded decls map, layout fields w/h = rect size,
  x/y = centre relative to parent centre), `Builder` (statements → nodes).
- `types.rs` — built-in type registry (name, primitive, base, defaults as lini decl text).
- `style.rs` — value helpers (`value_num(s)`, `ident_of`, colour/weight/dash serialisation).
- `compile.rs` — `Ctx` (all state), `cascade()` (type chain base-first: defaults then user
  `|type|` rules; then classes; id rules; inline), `compute()` fills `ctx.comp[i]: Computed`
  (font size/weight/family, padding, gap, direction, align, justify, width/height, stroke…).
- `layout.rs` — `measure()` dispatch (text, line/poly/path geometry, chart hook, grid, flow).
  `outer(ctx,i)` = rect size + stroke width when stroke != none (text: its box).
- `render.rs` — SVG + stylesheet. CSS rules are collected as (slot, text) and sorted by
  `SLOT_ORDER`; families push extra rules into `out.extra_rules`. Root `--lini-*` vars are
  emitted for every var referenced (`use_var(&mut out.vars, name)`), sorted by name.
  The scope class is `lini-scope-` + hash8(style text written with `.lini` as scope).
- `util.rs` — `f4()` (all coordinates: `{:.4}` then trim zeros; "-0"→"0"), `hash8()` (FNV-1a 64,
  folded hi^lo, 8 hex), `xml_escape`, `base64`, `levenshtein`.
- `font.rs` — bundled TTFs (extracted via `--embed-font`); `text_width(family, weight, size, s)`.
- `markers.rs` — arrow/dot/diamond line-end markers. `geom.rs` — SVG path bbox.

## Facts learned so far (all verified against the original)
- Text box: width = Σ advances·size/1000 (+ letter-spacing·(n−1)); height = size for one line,
  n·1.2·size + (n−1)·line-spacing for n lines. Text renders `<text class="lini-text" x y
  dy="0.358em">`; multi-line uses tspans (first y = centre − (n−1)·pitch/2 + 0.358·size).
- Inline `style="…"` on a node = its own/inline decls minus those equal to what its CSS rules
  (type chain + classes) already give, in CSS_ORDER.
- Indentation: 2 spaces per nesting level; scene children start at 4.
- Only the first error is reported (`file:line:col: error: msg`, exit 1); warnings are printed
  before the SVG and do not change exit code (unless --strict).

## Status (after wave 2) — modules now in the tree
- `chart.rs` + `chart/*` (charts & pies, done), `table.rs` (tables/entity), `page.rs` (sheets,

## Links (already in place)
- `scene::Builder::resolve_links()` resolves every link statement after the node tree is built:
  ids are scoped (a node with an id opens a scope for its descendants; anonymous containers are
  transparent), bare unknown names auto-create `|box#name| "name"` appended to the container,
  dotted paths resolve scope by scope, chains/fans expand in statement order (cartesian, `from`
  outer). Result: `ctx.links: Vec<scene::Link>` (from/to node indices, op string like "->",
  "-->", "<->", "~>", "-o<", "(-)", "(o)", "<-", "||" …, label, labels block, classes, style decls,
  from/to anchors (`a:right`), pattern index (`p.2`), the container node, the statement span).
  Rendering of links is NOT implemented yet (`<g class="lini-links"/>` is always empty).
- `subcommands`: fmt (src/format*), highlight (src/highlight.rs) are DONE and verified — don't touch.

## Working rules
- Put your feature in its own module(s); keep edits to shared files (main.rs, layout.rs,

  them in parallel and we merge branches afterwards.
- Commit your work on your branch in your worktree (`git add -A && git commit -m ...`) when
  done, and report: what passes, what doesn't, and any shared-file changes you made.
